Document ID: SRS-DB-001 | Version 1.0 | July 6, 2026

Physical Data Model (PDM)

Inventory Management System — PostgreSQL

Document Information

Attribute Detail
Document ID SRS-DB-002
Document Title Physical Data Model — Inventory Management System
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Database Architect
Source Document SRS-DB-001 (Logical Data Model, v1.0)
Target Platform PostgreSQL 15+
Date July 6, 2026
Scope Physical table design — no DDL/SQL statements

Purpose

This document converts the approved Logical Data Model (SRS-DB-001) into a Physical Data Model for PostgreSQL. It defines tables, columns, data types, nullability, defaults, and growth characteristics following PostgreSQL best practices.

Physical Design Conventions

Convention Standard
Naming snake_case for schemas, tables, and columns
Primary keys BIGINT surrogate id, GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY
Business keys Natural identifiers (sku, location_code, order_number) as UNIQUE alternate keys
Quantities NUMERIC(18,4) — never FLOAT/REAL
Monetary amounts NUMERIC(18,2)
Timestamps TIMESTAMPTZ (UTC storage)
Dates DATE for calendar dates without time
Status / type codes VARCHAR(32) with application-enforced domain values
Descriptions / notes TEXT
Flexible snapshots JSONB for audit before/after state only
Optimistic locking version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 on mutable transactional headers
Audit columns created_at, updated_at on all mutable tables; created_by where attribution required
Soft delete is_active BOOLEAN on master data — no hard delete of reference rows
Referential integrity Foreign keys within same bounded context; cross-context references by business key or loose FK with deferred validation
High-volume tables Time-based range partitioning (monthly) on movement_timestamp / event_timestamp
Indexing strategy B-tree on FKs and status filters; composite indexes on (product_id, location_id) hot paths

Schema Layout

Schema Purpose
catalog Product master data
network Locations and storage positions
governance Policies and reason codes
inventory Stock balances, lots, holds, policies
procurement Suppliers, requisitions, purchase orders
inbound Goods receipt, discrepancies, put-away
finance Supplier invoices and three-way match
fulfillment Customer orders, reservations, picks, shipments
transfer Inter-location transfers
accuracy Cycle counts, physical counts, adjustments, write-offs
returns RMA, customer returns, dispositions
commercial Promotional stock allocations
identity Users and role assignments
audit Movement log, audit trail, alerts, valuation snapshots

Growth Tier Legend

Tier Annual Row Estimate (mid-size deployment) Strategy
Low < 50K Standard B-tree indexes
Medium 50K – 5M Composite indexes; archive closed documents > 3 years
High 5M – 50M Partitioning; read replicas for reporting
Very High > 50M Monthly partitions; cold storage archive; BRIN on timestamps

Domain 1: Catalog (catalog schema)

Table: catalog.products

Attribute Detail
Business Purpose Canonical SKU master — identity for all inventory operations across locations and channels.
Estimated Growth Low — ~10K–100K SKUs; stable with slow churn.
Column Data Type Nullable Default Description
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY Surrogate primary key
sku VARCHAR(64) NO — Business key; stock keeping unit
product_name VARCHAR(256) NO — Display name
description TEXT YES NULL Extended description
unit_of_measure VARCHAR(16) NO — EA, CS, KG, etc.
category_code VARCHAR(64) YES NULL Product category reference
lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NO 'ACTIVE' ACTIVE, INACTIVE, DISCONTINUED
abc_classification VARCHAR(1) YES NULL A, B, or C
is_shelf_life BOOLEAN NO FALSE Shelf-life product indicator
is_traceable BOOLEAN NO FALSE Lot/batch tracking required
rotation_policy VARCHAR(8) YES NULL FIFO or FEFO
mrsl_days INTEGER YES NULL Minimum remaining shelf life policy (days)
superseded_by_sku VARCHAR(64) YES NULL Replacement SKU if discontinued
is_active BOOLEAN NO TRUE Soft-delete flag
version INTEGER NO 1 Optimistic lock
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Record creation
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Last modification
created_by BIGINT YES NULL FK → identity.user_accounts.id

Table: catalog.product_identifiers

Attribute Detail
Business Purpose Alternate product identifiers (barcodes, vendor codes) for lookup at receipt and pick.
Estimated Growth Low — ~1–3 identifiers per product.
Column Data Type Nullable Default Description
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY Surrogate primary key
product_id BIGINT NO — FK → catalog.products.id
identifier_type VARCHAR(32) NO — BARCODE, VENDOR_CODE, GTIN, etc.
identifier_value VARCHAR(128) NO — Identifier string
is_primary BOOLEAN NO FALSE Primary scan identifier
is_active BOOLEAN NO TRUE Soft-delete flag
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Record creation

Domain 2: Network (network schema)

Table: network.inventory_locations

Attribute Detail
Business Purpose Physical sites (warehouses, stores, DCs) anchoring all stock balances and operations.
Estimated Growth Low — tens to low hundreds of locations.
Column Data Type Nullable Default Description
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY Surrogate primary key
location_code VARCHAR(32) NO — Business key
location_name VARCHAR(256) NO — Display name
location_type VARCHAR(32) NO — WAREHOUSE, STORE, DISTRIBUTION_POINT
parent_location_id BIGINT YES NULL Self-FK for hierarchy
operational_status VARCHAR(32) NO 'ACTIVE' ACTIVE, PLANNED, CLOSING, INACTIVE
is_frozen BOOLEAN NO FALSE Physical count freeze flag (BR-024)
address_line1 VARCHAR(256) YES NULL Street address
address_line2 VARCHAR(256) YES NULL Address continuation
city VARCHAR(128) YES NULL City
region_code VARCHAR(32) YES NULL State/province/region
postal_code VARCHAR(16) YES NULL Postal/ZIP code
country_code CHAR(2) YES NULL ISO 3166-1 alpha-2
responsible_manager_id BIGINT YES NULL FK → identity.user_accounts.id
go_live_date DATE YES NULL Operational start date
closure_plan TEXT YES NULL Closure disposition plan
is_active BOOLEAN NO TRUE Soft-delete flag
version INTEGER NO 1 Optimistic lock
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Record creation
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Last modification

Table: network.storage_positions

Attribute Detail
Business Purpose Bin/zone/shelf addresses within a location for put-away and pick path.
Estimated Growth Low–Medium — thousands per large warehouse.
Column Data Type Nullable Default Description
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY Surrogate primary key
location_id BIGINT NO — FK → network.inventory_locations.id
position_code VARCHAR(64) NO — Unique within location
zone VARCHAR(32) YES NULL Zone designation
aisle VARCHAR(32) YES NULL Aisle designation
bin VARCHAR(32) YES NULL Bin designation
storage_type VARCHAR(32) NO 'BULK' BULK, PICK_FACE, QUARANTINE, BONDED
capacity_units NUMERIC(18,4) YES NULL Optional capacity limit
is_dedicated BOOLEAN NO FALSE Product-dedicated position
dedicated_product_id BIGINT YES NULL FK → catalog.products.id
is_active BOOLEAN NO TRUE Soft-delete flag
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Record creation
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Last modification

Domain 3: Governance (governance schema)

Table: governance.governance_policies

Attribute Detail
Business Purpose Organization-wide approval thresholds, tolerances, and exception rules.
Estimated Growth Low — versioned policy set; < 1K active versions.
Column Data Type Nullable Default Description
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY Surrogate primary key
policy_code VARCHAR(64) NO — Business identifier
policy_name VARCHAR(256) NO — Display name
policy_type VARCHAR(32) NO — APPROVAL_THRESHOLD, TOLERANCE, ACCESS, EXCEPTION
threshold_value NUMERIC(18,4) YES NULL Numeric threshold
threshold_currency CHAR(3) YES NULL ISO 4217 for financial thresholds
applicable_scope VARCHAR(64) YES NULL Location, role, or transaction scope
approval_authority_role VARCHAR(64) YES NULL Required approver role
effective_from TIMESTAMPTZ NO — Policy effective start
effective_to TIMESTAMPTZ YES NULL Policy effective end (NULL = open)
is_active BOOLEAN NO TRUE Soft-delete flag
version INTEGER NO 1 Optimistic lock
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Record creation
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Last modification

Table: governance.reason_codes

Attribute Detail
Business Purpose Standardized categorized explanations for adjustments, write-offs, and discrepancies.
Estimated Growth Low — ~50–200 codes.
Column Data Type Nullable Default Description
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY Surrogate primary key
reason_code VARCHAR(32) NO — Business key
description VARCHAR(512) NO — Human-readable label
category VARCHAR(32) NO — ADJUSTMENT, SHRINKAGE, DAMAGE, OBSOLESCENCE, RECEIPT_DISCREPANCY, RETURN, OTHER
reporting_group VARCHAR(64) YES NULL Reporting rollup group
approval_threshold_id BIGINT YES NULL FK → governance.governance_policies.id
is_active BOOLEAN NO TRUE Retired codes set FALSE
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Record creation
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Last modification

Domain 4: Inventory Balance (inventory schema)

Table: inventory.stock_positions

Attribute Detail
Business Purpose Authoritative on-hand, reserved, and ATP quantities per product per location — central quantity hub.
Estimated Growth Medium — product × location combinations; ~100K–2M rows. Hot contention table.
Column Data Type Nullable Default Description
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY Surrogate primary key
product_id BIGINT NO — FK → catalog.products.id
location_id BIGINT NO — FK → network.inventory_locations.id
on_hand_qty NUMERIC(18,4) NO 0 Physical on-hand quantity
reserved_qty NUMERIC(18,4) NO 0 Committed to orders
quarantined_qty NUMERIC(18,4) NO 0 Held / non-sellable quantity
atp_qty NUMERIC(18,4) NO 0 Available-to-promise (derived: on_hand − reserved − quarantined)
inbound_expected_qty NUMERIC(18,4) NO 0 Informational pipeline quantity
stock_status VARCHAR(32) NO 'IN_STOCK' IN_STOCK, LOW_STOCK, OUT_OF_STOCK, OVERSTOCK
ownership_type VARCHAR(32) NO 'OWNED' OWNED, CONSIGNMENT, BONDED
last_movement_at TIMESTAMPTZ YES NULL Last quantity change timestamp
version INTEGER NO 1 Optimistic lock — critical for concurrent reservations
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Record creation
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Last modification

Table: inventory.lot_batches

Attribute Detail
Business Purpose Traceable lot/batch identity with shelf-life attributes for FEFO and recall.
Estimated Growth Medium–High — new lot per receipt batch; 500K–10M rows over time.
Column Data Type Nullable Default Description
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY Surrogate primary key
stock_position_id BIGINT NO — FK → inventory.stock_positions.id
product_id BIGINT NO — FK → catalog.products.id (denormalized for query)
lot_number VARCHAR(64) NO — Lot/batch business identifier
quantity NUMERIC(18,4) NO 0 Quantity in this lot at position
expiration_date DATE YES NULL Product expiration
manufacture_date DATE YES NULL Manufacture date
receipt_date DATE YES NULL First receipt date
quality_status VARCHAR(32) NO 'ACCEPTED' ACCEPTED, HOLD, REJECTED
supplier_id BIGINT YES NULL FK → procurement.suppliers.id
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Record creation
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Last modification

Table: inventory.quarantine_holds

Attribute Detail
Business Purpose Holds removing quantity from ATP for quality, regulatory, recall, or customs reasons.
Estimated Growth Medium — active holds low; historical ~100K–1M.
Column Data Type Nullable Default Description
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY Surrogate primary key
hold_reference VARCHAR(64) NO — Business reference number
stock_position_id BIGINT NO — FK → inventory.stock_positions.id
lot_batch_id BIGINT YES NULL FK → inventory.lot_batches.id
held_qty NUMERIC(18,4) NO — Quantity under hold
hold_type VARCHAR(32) NO — QUALITY, REGULATORY, RECALL, CUSTOMS, INVESTIGATION
hold_reason TEXT NO — Hold justification
hold_status VARCHAR(32) NO 'ACTIVE' ACTIVE, RELEASED, DISPOSED
hold_start_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Hold effective start
expected_resolution_at TIMESTAMPTZ YES NULL Expected release date
released_at TIMESTAMPTZ YES NULL Actual release timestamp
disposition_outcome VARCHAR(32) YES NULL RESTOCK, WRITE_OFF, DESTROY
authorized_by BIGINT YES NULL FK → identity.user_accounts.id
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Record creation
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Last modification

Table: inventory.stock_policies

Attribute Detail
Business Purpose Replenishment thresholds per product per location.
Estimated Growth Medium — mirrors stock position cardinality; ~100K–2M.
Column Data Type Nullable Default Description
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY Surrogate primary key
product_id BIGINT NO — FK → catalog.products.id
location_id BIGINT NO — FK → network.inventory_locations.id
reorder_level NUMERIC(18,4) NO 0 ATP trigger for replenishment
minimum_threshold NUMERIC(18,4) NO 0 Minimum stock floor
safety_stock_qty NUMERIC(18,4) NO 0 Safety buffer
maximum_stock_level NUMERIC(18,4) YES NULL Overstock indicator
lead_time_days INTEGER YES NULL Assumed lead time
review_frequency_days INTEGER YES NULL Replenishment review cadence
effective_from TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Current threshold effective date
exception_approval_ref VARCHAR(64) YES NULL Authorized exception reference
version INTEGER NO 1 Optimistic lock
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Record creation
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Last modification

Table: inventory.stock_policy_history

Data Dictionary

Inventory Management System — PostgreSQL

Document Information

Attribute Detail
Document ID SRS-DB-007
Document Title Data Dictionary — Inventory Management System
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Database Architect
Source Document SRS-DB-002 (Physical Data Model, v1.0)
Target Platform PostgreSQL 15+
Date July 6, 2026

Purpose

This document provides a developer- and business-analyst-friendly reference for every table and column in the Inventory Management System database. It translates the Physical Data Model (SRS-DB-002) into plain-language business definitions, relationship notes, and data-type conventions — without DDL or SQL.

Conventions Used in This Document

Convention Meaning
Nullable YES = column may be empty; NO = column is required
Default Value assigned automatically when a row is inserted without an explicit value; — means no default
Related Entity → schema.table (column) for foreign keys; — (primary key) for surrogate PKs; business-key uniqueness noted where applicable
Business Meaning One-sentence plain-language explanation suitable for business analysts
Naming All identifiers use snake_case per PDM standards

Schema Index — All Tables (58)

# Schema.Table One-Line Description
1 catalog.products Canonical SKU master — identity for all inventory operations across locations and channels.

All table definitions present in SRS-DB-002 are documented below (58 tables). PDM Appendix A inventory summary cites 59 tables across 14 schemas.

catalog.products

Table description: Canonical SKU master — identity for all inventory operations across locations and channels.

Column Data Type Nullable Default Business Meaning Related Entity
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY System-generated unique identifier for this record. — (primary key)
sku VARCHAR(64) NO — Unique business identifier for this record (stock keeping unit). Unique business key
product_name VARCHAR(256) NO — The human-readable name shown to users in screens and reports. —
description TEXT YES — Optional longer text describing additional details. —
unit_of_measure VARCHAR(16) NO — Unit of measure for counting and transacting this product (e.g., each, case, kilogram). —
category_code VARCHAR(64) YES — Code referencing the product's merchandise or category grouping. —
lifecycle_status VARCHAR(32) NO 'ACTIVE' Catalog lifecycle status indicating whether the product is sellable. —
abc_classification VARCHAR(1) YES — ABC classification ranking inventory importance or turnover velocity. —
is_shelf_life BOOLEAN NO FALSE Indicates whether this product requires expiration-date tracking. —
is_traceable BOOLEAN NO FALSE Indicates whether this product must be tracked by lot or batch number. —
rotation_policy VARCHAR(8) YES — Stock rotation policy: first-in-first-out or first-expired-first-out. —
mrsl_days INTEGER YES — Minimum days of shelf life required before the product may be sold or shipped. —
superseded_by_sku VARCHAR(64) YES — SKU of the successor product when this item is discontinued. → catalog.products (sku)
is_active BOOLEAN NO TRUE Indicates whether this master-data record is active; deactivated records are retained for history. —
version INTEGER NO 1 Version counter incremented on each update to prevent conflicting concurrent edits. —
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Timestamp when this record was first created in the system. —
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Timestamp of the most recent update to this record. —
created_by BIGINT YES — The user who created this record. → identity.user_accounts (id)

catalog.product_identifiers

Table description: Alternate product identifiers (barcodes, vendor codes) for lookup at receipt and pick.

Column Data Type Nullable Default Business Meaning Related Entity
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY System-generated unique identifier for this record. — (primary key)
product_id BIGINT NO — The product this record pertains to. → catalog.products (id)
identifier_type VARCHAR(32) NO — Type of alternate identifier (barcode, vendor code, GTIN, etc.). —
identifier_value VARCHAR(128) NO — The scanned or keyed identifier value. —
is_primary BOOLEAN NO FALSE Indicates whether this is the default identifier used when scanning. —
is_active BOOLEAN NO TRUE Indicates whether this master-data record is active; deactivated records are retained for history. —
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NO NOW() Timestamp when this record was first created in the system. —

network.inventory_locations

Table description: Physical sites (warehouses, stores, DCs) anchoring all stock balances and operations.

Column Data Type Nullable Default Business Meaning Related Entity
id BIGINT NO IDENTITY System-generated unique identifier for this record. — (primary key)
location_code VARCHAR(32) NO — Unique business identifier used in day-to-day operations. Unique business key
location_name VARCHAR(256) NO — The human-readable name shown to users in screens and reports. —
location_type VARCHAR(32) NO — Type of physical site (warehouse, store, or distribution point). —
parent_location_id BIGINT YES — Optional reference to a parent location in the site hierarchy. → network.inventory_locations (id)
operational_status VARCHAR(32) NO 'ACTIVE' Operational status of the location. —
is_frozen BOOLEAN NO FALSE Indicates the location is frozen and inventory movements are blocked during a physical count. —

Appendix A: Data Type Legend

Data Type Business Meaning
BIGINT Large whole number; used for primary keys and foreign key references
INTEGER Whole number for counts, days, and version counters
NUMERIC(18,4) Precise decimal for quantities — never floating-point
NUMERIC(18,2) Precise decimal for monetary amounts
NUMERIC(3,2) Decimal with limited precision (e.g., ratings 0.00–5.00)
VARCHAR(n) Variable-length text up to n characters; used for codes, names, and status values
CHAR(n) Fixed-length text; used for ISO codes (country, currency)
TEXT Unlimited-length text for descriptions, notes, and evidence
BOOLEAN True/false flag
DATE Calendar date without time component
TIMESTAMPTZ Date and time stored in UTC with timezone awareness
JSONB Structured JSON snapshot for audit before/after state

Appendix B: Standard Audit Columns

Many tables share common audit and control columns. Their business purpose is consistent across the model:

Column Typical Presence Business Meaning
id All tables Surrogate primary key generated automatically by the database
version Mutable transactional headers Optimistic lock counter preventing lost updates during concurrent edits
is_active Master/reference data Soft-delete flag; inactive rows are retained but excluded from operational use
created_at Most mutable tables When the record was first created
updated_at Most mutable tables When the record was last modified
created_by Documents requiring attribution User who created the record
line_number Document line tables Sequence position of the line within its parent document

Appendix C: Entity Relationship Overview

High-level data flow and relationships across bounded contexts:

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                           FOUNDATION LAYER                                   │
│  catalog.products ◄──── catalog.product_identifiers                          │
│  network.inventory_locations ◄── network.storage_positions (self-hierarchy)  │
│  governance.governance_policies ◄── governance.reason_codes                  │
│  identity.user_accounts ◄── identity.role_assignments ◄── role_assignment_locations │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                      │
                                      ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         INVENTORY CORE (quantity hub)                        │
│  inventory.stock_positions (product × location)                              │
│       ├── inventory.lot_batches                                              │
│       ├── inventory.quarantine_holds                                         │
│       └── inventory.stock_policies ──► inventory.stock_policy_history        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
          ▲                    ▲                    ▲                    ▲
          │                    │                    │                    │
   PROCUREMENT            INBOUND              FULFILLMENT           TRANSFER
          │                    │                    │                    │
 procurement.suppliers   inbound.goods_receipts   fulfillment.customer_orders   transfer.transfer_requests
 procurement.purchase_*  inbound.goods_receipt_*  fulfillment.* (reservations,   transfer.stock_transfers
 expected_inbound_*        receipt_discrepancies      picks, shipments, backorders)  in_transit_stock
          │                    │                    │                    │
          └──────── finance.supplier_invoices ◄─────┴────────────────────┘
                    (three-way match via invoice_goods_receipt_match)
                                      │
                                      ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    ACCURACY · RETURNS · COMMERCIAL                           │
│  accuracy.cycle_counts / physical_inventory_counts ──► count_variances       │
│       └── stock_adjustments · inventory_write_offs                           │
│  returns.return_authorizations ──► customer_returns ──► return_dispositions  │
│  commercial.promotional_stock_allocations ──► promotional_allocation_locations│
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                                      │
                                      ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                              AUDIT LAYER                                     │
│  audit.inventory_movement_records (append-only quantity changes)             │
│  audit.audit_trail_records (entity change snapshots)                         │
│  audit.operational_alerts (threshold & exception notifications)              │
│  audit.inventory_valuation_snapshots ──► inventory_valuation_lines           │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Key relationship patterns:

  • Product × Location hub: inventory.stock_positions is the central quantity record; most operational tables reference it directly or via product_id + location_id.
  • Document header / line pattern: Requisitions, POs, orders, receipts, transfers, and returns follow a header table with child line tables linked by parent FK.
  • Procure-to-receive: procurement.purchase_orders → inbound.goods_receipts → inbound.put_aways → stock position update.
  • Order-to-ship: fulfillment.customer_orders → inventory_reservations → fulfillment_executions → shipments.
  • Three-way match: finance.supplier_invoices linked to inbound.goods_receipts via invoice_goods_receipt_match, matched against purchase_order_lines.
  • Audit trail: Every material quantity change posts to audit.inventory_movement_records; governed entity changes post to audit.audit_trail_records.

End of Data Dictionary

Document ID: SRS-DB-007 | Version 1.0 | July 6, 2026

Database Keys Specification

Inventory Management System — PostgreSQL

Document Information

Attribute Detail
Document ID SRS-DB-003
Document Title Database Keys — Primary, Foreign, Unique, and Candidate Keys
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Database Architect
Source Documents SRS-DB-002 (Physical Data Model, v1.0), SRS-DB-001 (Logical Data Model, v1.0)
Target Platform PostgreSQL 15+
Date July 6, 2026
Scope Key definitions and business justification — no DDL/SQL statements

Purpose

This document defines all database keys for the 59 tables in the Inventory Management System physical model. For each table it identifies primary keys, foreign keys, unique keys, and candidate keys, with business justification aligned to domain rules (BR-001 – BR-032) and aggregate boundaries.

Key Design Principles

Principle Rationale
Surrogate primary key Every table uses id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY as PK — stable, narrow, immune to business identifier format changes
Business key as unique constraint Natural identifiers (sku, po_number, order_number) enforced as UNIQUE alternate keys for human lookup and external integration
Composite uniqueness for documents Header + line_number uniqueness on all document line tables prevents duplicate lines and supports ordered business documents
Dimensional uniqueness Product + Location composite UK on stock positions and policies enforces "one balance per SKU per site" invariant
Referential integrity via FK Parent-child and cross-schema references use foreign keys; optional deferred FKs on cross-bounded-context links where eventual consistency applies
Candidate keys documented All business-viable unique identifiers recorded even when not enforced as UK — guides future constraints and integration contracts

Key Notation

Symbol Meaning
PK Primary Key — cluster identity, join anchor
FK Foreign Key — referential integrity to parent table
UK Unique Key — enforced uniqueness constraint
CK Candidate Key — business identifier capable of unique identification; may or may not be enforced as UK

Domain 1: Catalog

catalog.products

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_products Stable internal reference for all inventory transactions; SKU format may evolve without breaking FKs across millions of movement records
UK sku uk_products_sku SKU is the canonical business identity (BR-027 gatekeeper); must be globally unique — two products cannot share a stock keeping unit
FK created_by → identity.user_accounts.id fk_products_created_by Attributes product master creation to an accountable user for audit (BO-19)
CK sku — Primary natural key; selected as UK because it is the ubiquitous language term used in all operational documents
CK (sku, lifecycle_status) — Not unique globally but identifies product state context; not enforced — status changes would violate UK

catalog.product_identifiers

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_product_identifiers Surrogate PK for alternate identifiers that may be added/retired without affecting product PK
FK product_id → catalog.products.id fk_product_identifiers_product Identifier belongs to exactly one product; composition within Product Catalog aggregate
UK (identifier_type, identifier_value) uk_product_identifiers_type_value A barcode/GTIN must map to one product globally — duplicate scan codes cause wrong picks and receipts (BR-004)
UK (product_id, identifier_type, identifier_value) uk_product_identifiers_product_type_value Prevents duplicate identifier rows on same product
CK identifier_value (when is_primary = TRUE) — Primary scan code per product; enforced via partial unique index concept: one primary per product

Domain 2: Network

network.inventory_locations

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_inventory_locations Stable anchor for all stock balances, receipts, and fulfillments at a site
UK location_code uk_inventory_locations_code Location code is the business identity used on POs, transfers, and reports; must be unique across the network
FK parent_location_id → network.inventory_locations.id fk_inventory_locations_parent Optional hierarchy (region → site); self-reference enables roll-up reporting without duplicating location records
FK responsible_manager_id → identity.user_accounts.id fk_inventory_locations_manager Assigns operational accountability for location performance
CK location_code — Primary natural key; used in cross-aggregate identity references per DDD architecture
CK (location_code, operational_status) — Identifies location in a given state; not UK because status transitions are frequent

network.storage_positions

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_storage_positions Surrogate PK for bin-level addresses that may be reconfigured
FK location_id → network.inventory_locations.id fk_storage_positions_location Position cannot exist outside parent location — composition within Inventory Location aggregate (REL-004)
FK dedicated_product_id → catalog.products.id fk_storage_positions_product Optional dedicated-product bin assignment
UK (location_id, position_code) uk_storage_positions_location_code Position code unique within location only — "A-01-03" may repeat at different warehouses
CK (location_id, zone, aisle, bin) — Physical address composite; not enforced as UK because addressing scheme may have gaps

Domain 3: Governance

governance.governance_policies

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_governance_policies Supports policy versioning without recycling business codes
UK (policy_code, effective_from) uk_governance_policies_code_effective One version per policy code per effective period — prevents overlapping policy versions (BR-021)
CK policy_code — Human-readable policy reference; not alone unique due to versioning
CK (policy_type, applicable_scope, effective_from) — Identifies active policy for a scope at a point in time; used by application lookup

governance.reason_codes

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_reason_codes Stable reference for historical adjustments even after code retirement
UK reason_code uk_reason_codes_code Reason code is the business taxonomy key — mandatory on adjustments (BR-020); must not duplicate
FK approval_threshold_id → governance.governance_policies.id fk_reason_codes_policy Links reason category to approval threshold when material
CK reason_code — Primary natural key; selected as UK

Domain 4: Inventory Balance

inventory.stock_positions

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_stock_positions Hot-path join key for reservations, movements, and adjustments — narrow BIGINT for lock efficiency
UK (product_id, location_id) uk_stock_positions_product_location Core domain invariant — exactly one balance per SKU per location; prevents split-brain ATP (BR-001, REL-019, REL-020)
FK product_id → catalog.products.id fk_stock_positions_product Balance tracks a valid catalog product
FK location_id → network.inventory_locations.id fk_stock_positions_location Balance anchored to a valid location
CK (product_id, location_id) — Primary candidate key; enforced as UK
CK (product_id, location_id, ownership_type) — Not unique — ownership is attribute not identity

inventory.lot_batches

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_lot_batches Surrogate PK; lot numbers may repeat across products
FK stock_position_id → inventory.stock_positions.id fk_lot_batches_stock_position Lot quantity belongs to parent stock position — composition (REL-023)
FK product_id → catalog.products.id fk_lot_batches_product Denormalized for FEFO queries without joining through stock position
FK supplier_id → procurement.suppliers.id fk_lot_batches_supplier Traceability to supplier origin for recall (BR-017, REL-134)
UK (product_id, lot_number, stock_position_id) uk_lot_batches_product_lot_position Same lot may exist at one position once; supports lot-level quantity tracking
CK (product_id, lot_number) — Lot identity within product scope per domain model; may span positions via separate rows

inventory.quarantine_holds

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_quarantine_holds Surrogate PK for hold lifecycle management
UK hold_reference uk_quarantine_holds_reference Business document number for hold tracking and customs clearance (BR-030)
FK stock_position_id → inventory.stock_positions.id fk_quarantine_holds_stock_position Hold applied to specific balance — composition (REL-022)
FK lot_batch_id → inventory.lot_batches.id fk_quarantine_holds_lot Optional lot-scoped hold for targeted recall (REL-028)
FK authorized_by → identity.user_accounts.id fk_quarantine_holds_authorized_by Hold authorization accountability
CK hold_reference — Primary business document key

inventory.stock_policies

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_stock_policies Surrogate PK; thresholds versioned via history table
UK (product_id, location_id) uk_stock_policies_product_location One replenishment policy per SKU per location — mirrors stock position identity (REL-008, REL-009)
FK product_id → catalog.products.id fk_stock_policies_product Policy scoped to product
FK location_id → network.inventory_locations.id fk_stock_policies_location Policy scoped to location
CK (product_id, location_id) — Primary candidate key; same composite as stock position

inventory.stock_policy_history

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_stock_policy_history Append-only history rows
FK stock_policy_id → inventory.stock_policies.id fk_stock_policy_history_policy History belongs to parent policy
FK changed_by → identity.user_accounts.id fk_stock_policy_history_changed_by Threshold change attribution
UK (stock_policy_id, effective_from) uk_stock_policy_history_policy_from Non-overlapping history periods per policy
CK (stock_policy_id, effective_from, effective_to) — Identifies a specific threshold version window

Domain 5: Procurement

procurement.suppliers

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_suppliers Stable vendor reference across PO, receipt, and invoice chains
UK supplier_code uk_suppliers_code Supplier code is commercial identity — unique counterparty for procurement (BR-007, BR-008)
CK supplier_code — Primary natural key

procurement.purchase_requisitions

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_purchase_requisitions Surrogate PK for requisition lifecycle
UK requisition_number uk_purchase_requisitions_number Internal document number for approval workflow traceability
FK requesting_location_id → network.inventory_locations.id fk_purchase_requisitions_location Replenishment need anchored to destination site (REL-036)
FK triggering_alert_id → audit.operational_alerts.id fk_purchase_requisitions_alert Links requisition to low-stock alert that triggered it (REL-038, BR-009)
FK approved_by → identity.user_accounts.id fk_purchase_requisitions_approved_by Approval accountability
FK purchase_order_id → procurement.purchase_orders.id fk_purchase_requisitions_po Conversion traceability — requisition to PO (REL-037)
FK created_by → identity.user_accounts.id fk_purchase_requisitions_created_by Initiator attribution
CK requisition_number — Primary business document key

procurement.purchase_requisition_lines

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_purchase_requisition_lines Line-level surrogate PK
FK requisition_id → procurement.purchase_requisitions.id fk_purchase_requisition_lines_req Line belongs to parent requisition
FK product_id → catalog.products.id fk_purchase_requisition_lines_product Line references active product — discontinued blocked (BR-027)
UK (requisition_id, line_number) uk_purchase_requisition_lines_req_line Ordered line sequence unique within requisition
CK (requisition_id, product_id) — Not UK — same product could theoretically appear on amended lines; line_number disambiguates

procurement.purchase_orders

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_purchase_orders Stable PO reference for receipt and three-way match
UK po_number uk_purchase_orders_number PO number is authorization document for inbound receipt (BR-007)
FK supplier_id → procurement.suppliers.id fk_purchase_orders_supplier Commercial commitment to vendor (REL-039)
FK receiving_location_id → network.inventory_locations.id fk_purchase_orders_location Designated receipt site (REL-040)
FK created_by → identity.user_accounts.id fk_purchase_orders_created_by Buyer attribution
CK po_number — Primary natural key
CK (supplier_id, po_number) — Redundant when po_number is globally unique; supplier-scoped numbering alternative if numbering scheme changes

procurement.purchase_order_lines

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_purchase_order_lines Line surrogate PK
FK purchase_order_id → procurement.purchase_orders.id fk_purchase_order_lines_po Line belongs to PO
FK product_id → catalog.products.id fk_purchase_order_lines_product Ordered product — discontinued prohibited (BR-027, REL-041)
UK (purchase_order_id, line_number) uk_purchase_order_lines_po_line Unique line sequence within PO
CK (purchase_order_id, product_id) — Identifies product on PO; not UK if same SKU ordered on multiple lines intentionally

procurement.expected_inbound_deliveries

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_expected_inbound_deliveries Surrogate PK
UK delivery_reference uk_expected_inbound_deliveries_ref Shipment plan business identifier
FK purchase_order_id → procurement.purchase_orders.id fk_expected_inbound_deliveries_po Delivery subordinate to PO — composition (REL-042)
FK receiving_location_id → network.inventory_locations.id fk_expected_inbound_deliveries_location Expected arrival site
CK delivery_reference — Primary business key

procurement.expected_inbound_delivery_lines

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_expected_inbound_delivery_lines Line surrogate PK
FK delivery_id → procurement.expected_inbound_deliveries.id fk_expected_inbound_delivery_lines_delivery Line belongs to delivery plan
FK purchase_order_line_id → procurement.purchase_order_lines.id fk_expected_inbound_delivery_lines_pol Links expected qty to authorized PO line (REL-045)
FK product_id → catalog.products.id fk_expected_inbound_delivery_lines_product Product denormalized for visibility queries
UK (delivery_id, purchase_order_line_id) uk_expected_inbound_delivery_lines One expected quantity entry per PO line per delivery

Domain 6: Inbound

inbound.goods_receipts

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_goods_receipts Receipt document anchor for put-away and three-way match
UK gr_number uk_goods_receipts_number Goods receipt number is operational document identity (BR-004)
FK purchase_order_id → procurement.purchase_orders.id fk_goods_receipts_po PO authorization for receipt (BR-007, REL-043); nullable for ad-hoc exception
FK supplier_id → procurement.suppliers.id fk_goods_receipts_supplier Supplier accountability (REL-048)
FK receiving_location_id → network.inventory_locations.id fk_goods_receipts_location Receipt site — blocked when frozen (BR-024, REL-049)
FK receiving_clerk_id → identity.user_accounts.id fk_goods_receipts_clerk Receiving clerk attribution (REL-126)
CK gr_number — Primary business document key

inbound.goods_receipt_lines

Key Type Column(s) Constraint Name (logical) Business Justification
PK id pk_goods_receipt_lines Line surrogate PK
FK goods_receipt_id → inbound.goods_receipts.id fk_goods_receipt_lines_gr Line belongs to receipt
FK purchase_order_line_id → procurement.purchase_order_lines.id fk_goods_receipt_lines_pol Verification against PO line
FK product_id → catalog.products.id fk_goods_receipt_lines_product Received product identity
FK lot_batch_id → inventory.lot_batches.id fk_goods_receipt_lines_lot Lot captured at receipt (BR-017, REL-052)
UK (goods_receipt_id, line_number) uk_goods_receipt_lines_gr_line Unique line sequence within receipt

inbound.receipt_discrepancies

Appendix A: Primary Key Summary

All 59 tables use id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY as the sole primary key column.

Design Decision Business Justification
Surrogate over natural PK Business identifiers (SKU, PO number) can change format, merge, or require soft-retirement without cascading PK updates across high-volume child tables
Single-column PK Simplifies ORM mapping, partition management, and FK definitions
BIGINT not INT Supports very high-volume tables (movement records, order lines) without ID exhaustion
No composite PKs Composite business uniqueness enforced via UK constraints — separates physical row identity from business identity

Appendix B: Foreign Key Relationship Map

Child Table Parent Table Cardinality ON DELETE Policy (recommended) Business Rule
inventory.stock_positions catalog.products N:1 RESTRICT Cannot delete product with balances
inventory.stock_positions network.inventory_locations N:1 RESTRICT Cannot delete location with stock
fulfillment.inventory_reservations inventory.stock_positions N:1 RESTRICT Reservation requires valid balance
inbound.goods_receipts procurement.purchase_orders N:1 RESTRICT PO required for receipt (BR-007)
inbound.put_aways inbound.goods_receipts N:1 RESTRICT Put-away requires receipt
accuracy.stock_adjustments governance.reason_codes N:1 RESTRICT Reason mandatory (BR-020)
accuracy.count_variances accuracy.cycle_counts N:1 RESTRICT Variance traceable to count
returns.customer_returns returns.return_authorizations N:1 RESTRICT RMA required (BR-025)
finance.invoice_goods_receipt_match finance.supplier_invoices N:1 CASCADE Match rows die with invoice draft
identity.role_assignments identity.user_accounts N:1 CASCADE Assignments removed with user deprovisioning
audit.inventory_movement_records inventory.stock_positions N:1 RESTRICT Movement history preserved

Cross-schema FK note: Foreign keys spanning bounded contexts (e.g., fulfillment → inventory) enforce referential integrity at persistence time. Cross-aggregate coordination still uses domain events per architecture — FKs prevent orphan rows, not distributed transactions.

Appendix C: Unique Key Catalog

Table Unique Key Column(s) Enforces Business Rule
catalog.products sku Global SKU uniqueness
catalog.product_identifiers (identifier_type, identifier_value) No duplicate scan codes
network.inventory_locations location_code Network location identity
network.storage_positions (location_id, position_code) Bin unique within site
inventory.stock_positions (product_id, location_id) One balance per SKU per site
inventory.stock_policies (product_id, location_id) One policy per SKU per site
inventory.lot_batches (product_id, lot_number, stock_position_id) Lot quantity uniqueness at position
procurement.suppliers supplier_code Vendor identity
procurement.purchase_orders po_number PO document identity
finance.supplier_invoices (supplier_id, invoice_number) AP invoice uniqueness
fulfillment.customer_orders order_number Order identity
governance.reason_codes reason_code Taxonomy uniqueness
identity.user_accounts user_identifier Login uniqueness
governance.governance_policies (policy_code, effective_from) Policy version uniqueness
finance.invoice_goods_receipt_match (supplier_invoice_id, goods_receipt_id) Single match pair
commercial.promotional_allocation_locations (allocation_id, location_id) One location entry per campaign
audit.inventory_valuation_lines (snapshot_id, product_id, location_id) Snapshot line uniqueness
All *_lines tables (parent_id, line_number) Document line ordering

Appendix D: Candidate Key Reference

Candidate keys not enforced as UK are retained for integration contracts and future constraint hardening.

Table Candidate Key Why Not Enforced as UK
fulfillment.shipments tracking_identifier Carrier may assign tracking late or reuse across carriers
procurement.purchase_order_lines (purchase_order_id, product_id) Same SKU may appear on multiple lines (different prices/dates)
audit.inventory_movement_records (source_document_type, source_document_id, stock_position_id) Multiple movements per source document (partial shipments)
accuracy.count_variances (cycle_count_id) XOR (physical_count_id) Enforced via CHECK constraint, not UK
commercial.promotional_stock_allocations (product_id, campaign_name, effective_start_date) Campaign names may repeat across years

Appendix E: Keys Enforcing Critical Business Rules

Business Rule Key Enforcement
BR-001 ATP-only commitment uk_stock_positions_product_location ensures single authoritative balance per SKU/site
BR-002 Reservation at confirmation FK inventory_reservations.stock_position_id binds hold to specific balance
BR-005 Put-away before availability FK chain put_aways → goods_receipts → purchase_orders enforces receipt workflow
BR-007 PO required for receipt FK goods_receipts.purchase_order_id (nullable only for documented exception)
BR-008 Three-way match UK invoice_goods_receipt_match (supplier_invoice_id, goods_receipt_id)
BR-019 Independent count approval FK count_variances.approver_id ≠ cycle_counts.counter_id — application-enforced SoD
BR-020 Mandatory reason code FK stock_adjustments.reason_code_id NOT NULL + RESTRICT
BR-025 RMA required FK customer_returns.return_authorization_id NOT NULL
BR-027 No discontinued reorder FK to products + application lifecycle check on insert
BR-029 Promotional ring-fence UK promotional_allocation_locations (allocation_id, location_id)

Document ID: SRS-DB-003 | Version 1.0 | July 6, 2026

Database Constraints Specification

Inventory Management System — PostgreSQL

Document Information

Attribute Detail
Document ID SRS-DB-004
Document Title Database Constraints — Business Integrity Enforcement
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Database Architect
Source Documents SRS-DB-002 (Physical Data Model), SRS-DB-003 (Database Keys), SRS-BR-001 (Business Rules)
Target Platform PostgreSQL 15+
Date July 6, 2026
Scope Constraint definitions and business justification — no DDL/SQL statements

Purpose

This document defines all database constraints for the Inventory Management System. Each constraint enforces a business rule or data integrity invariant at the persistence layer. Constraints are named using the pattern {type}_{table}_{column_or_scope}.

Constraint Type Legend

Type Prefix Description
NOT NULL nn_ Column must contain a value
UNIQUE uk_ Column or combination must be unique
CHECK chk_ Value must satisfy a business rule expression
FOREIGN KEY fk_ Referential integrity to parent table
DEFAULT def_ Default value when not supplied on INSERT

Standard Platform Constraints

Applied uniformly unless a table explicitly omits a column.

Table Pattern Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
All tables id NOT NULL nn_*_id — Primary key identity must always exist
All tables id DEFAULT def_*_id IDENTITY — System-generated stable surrogate key
Mutable tables created_at NOT NULL nn_*_created_at BO-19 Every record has auditable creation timestamp
Mutable tables created_at DEFAULT def_*_created_at = NOW() BO-19 Auto-stamp creation time in UTC
Mutable transactional headers version NOT NULL nn_*_version — Optimistic locking counter required
Mutable transactional headers version DEFAULT def_*_version = 1 — Initial version on insert
Master data tables is_active NOT NULL nn_*_is_active — Soft-delete flag must be explicit
Master data tables is_active DEFAULT def_*_is_active = TRUE — New master records active by default

Shared Domain CHECK Registry

Reusable enumerated value constraints referenced by multiple tables.

Constraint Name Allowed Values Business Rule Justification
chk_domain_lifecycle_status ACTIVE, INACTIVE, DISCONTINUED BR-027 Controls product eligibility for procurement and reservation
chk_domain_abc_classification A, B, C BR-032 ABC class drives count frequency and alert priority
chk_domain_rotation_policy FIFO, FEFO BR-014, BR-015 Rotation discipline for picking and put-away
chk_domain_ownership_type OWNED, CONSIGNMENT, BONDED BR-031, BR-030 Ownership affects ATP, valuation, and customs hold
chk_domain_quantity_non_negative value >= 0 BR-001, LDM-01 Inventory quantities cannot be negative
chk_domain_quantity_positive value > 0 — Order/receipt line quantities must be meaningful
chk_domain_order_status DRAFT, CONFIRMED, PARTIAL, FULFILLED, CANCELLED BR-001, BR-002 Order lifecycle states
chk_domain_po_status OPEN, PARTIAL, CLOSED, CANCELLED BR-007 PO receipt authorization lifecycle
chk_domain_approval_status PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED (+ variants) BR-019, BR-021 Governance workflow states
chk_domain_hold_type QUALITY, REGULATORY, RECALL, CUSTOMS, INVESTIGATION BR-013, BR-030 Quarantine hold classification
chk_domain_disposition_decision RESTOCK, QUARANTINE, WRITE_OFF BR-026 Return outcome paths
chk_domain_movement_type RECEIPT, SHIPMENT, TRANSFER, ADJUSTMENT, WRITE_OFF, RESERVATION, RETURN, PUT_AWAY BR-017, BR-020 Movement log taxonomy

Domain 1: Catalog

catalog.products

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
sku NOT NULL nn_products_sku — SKU is mandatory product identity
sku UNIQUE uk_products_sku BR-027 Globally unique stock keeping unit
product_name NOT NULL nn_products_product_name — Product must be identifiable by name in operations
unit_of_measure NOT NULL nn_products_uom — All inventory quantities require a UOM
lifecycle_status NOT NULL nn_products_lifecycle_status BR-027 Status governs eligibility for new transactions
lifecycle_status DEFAULT def_products_lifecycle_status = 'ACTIVE' — New products enter as active
lifecycle_status CHECK chk_products_lifecycle_status BR-027 Only valid lifecycle states permitted
abc_classification CHECK chk_products_abc_classification BR-032 ABC must be A, B, or C when assigned
is_shelf_life NOT NULL nn_products_is_shelf_life BR-014, BR-016 Shelf-life flag required for MRSL enforcement
is_shelf_life DEFAULT def_products_is_shelf_life = FALSE — Most products are non-shelf-life
is_traceable NOT NULL nn_products_is_traceable BR-017 Traceability flag required
is_traceable DEFAULT def_products_is_traceable = FALSE — Traceability opt-in per product
rotation_policy CHECK chk_products_rotation_policy BR-014, BR-015 FIFO/FEFO only when specified
(is_traceable, rotation_policy) CHECK chk_products_traceable_rotation BR-017 Traceable products must declare rotation policy
(is_shelf_life, mrsl_days) CHECK chk_products_shelf_life_mrsl BR-016 Shelf-life products must have MRSL days > 0
is_active DEFAULT def_products_is_active = TRUE — Soft-delete default
version DEFAULT def_products_version = 1 — Optimistic lock initial value
created_by FOREIGN KEY fk_products_created_by → identity.user_accounts BO-19 Product creation attribution

catalog.product_identifiers

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
product_id NOT NULL nn_product_identifiers_product_id — Identifier must belong to a product
product_id FOREIGN KEY fk_product_identifiers_product → catalog.products BR-004 Parent product must exist for scan lookup
identifier_type NOT NULL nn_product_identifiers_type BR-004 Type distinguishes barcode from vendor code
identifier_value NOT NULL nn_product_identifiers_value BR-004 Empty identifier unusable at scan
(identifier_type, identifier_value) UNIQUE uk_product_identifiers_type_value BR-004 One product per scan code globally
(product_id, identifier_type, identifier_value) UNIQUE uk_product_identifiers_composite — No duplicate identifiers on same product
is_primary NOT NULL nn_product_identifiers_is_primary — Primary flag must be explicit
is_primary DEFAULT def_product_identifiers_is_primary = FALSE — Non-primary by default
is_active DEFAULT def_product_identifiers_is_active = TRUE — Active identifier by default

Domain 2: Network

network.inventory_locations

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
location_code NOT NULL nn_inventory_locations_code — Location code is mandatory network identity
location_code UNIQUE uk_inventory_locations_code — Unique site identifier across network
location_name NOT NULL nn_inventory_locations_name — Human-readable site name required
location_type NOT NULL nn_inventory_locations_type — Type drives operational capabilities
location_type CHECK chk_inventory_locations_type IN (WAREHOUSE, STORE, DISTRIBUTION_POINT) — Valid location types only
parent_location_id FOREIGN KEY fk_inventory_locations_parent → self — Hierarchy reference must be valid location
parent_location_id CHECK chk_inventory_locations_not_self_parent id ≠ parent_location_id — Location cannot be its own parent
operational_status NOT NULL nn_inventory_locations_status BR-024 Status controls transaction eligibility
operational_status DEFAULT def_inventory_locations_status = 'ACTIVE' — New locations active by default
operational_status CHECK chk_inventory_locations_status — ACTIVE, PLANNED, CLOSING, INACTIVE only
is_frozen NOT NULL nn_inventory_locations_is_frozen BR-024 Freeze flag must be explicit during wall count
is_frozen DEFAULT def_inventory_locations_is_frozen = FALSE BR-024 Locations not frozen by default
responsible_manager_id FOREIGN KEY fk_inventory_locations_manager → identity.user_accounts — Optional manager accountability
country_code CHECK chk_inventory_locations_country length = 2 — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 when provided

network.storage_positions

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
location_id NOT NULL nn_storage_positions_location_id BR-005 Position must belong to a location
location_id FOREIGN KEY fk_storage_positions_location → network.inventory_locations REL-004 Composition within location aggregate
position_code NOT NULL nn_storage_positions_code BR-005 Bin address required for put-away
(location_id, position_code) UNIQUE uk_storage_positions_location_code — Code unique within location only
storage_type NOT NULL nn_storage_positions_type BR-030 Storage type drives bonded/quarantine routing
storage_type DEFAULT def_storage_positions_type = 'BULK' — Default bulk storage
storage_type CHECK chk_storage_positions_type IN (BULK, PICK_FACE, QUARANTINE, BONDED) BR-030 Valid storage classifications
capacity_units CHECK chk_storage_positions_capacity >= 0 OR NULL — Capacity cannot be negative
dedicated_product_id FOREIGN KEY fk_storage_positions_product → catalog.products — Dedicated bin references valid product
(is_dedicated, dedicated_product_id) CHECK chk_storage_positions_dedicated — Dedicated product required when is_dedicated = TRUE

Domain 3: Governance

governance.governance_policies

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
policy_code NOT NULL nn_governance_policies_code BR-021 Policy must be identifiable
policy_name NOT NULL nn_governance_policies_name — Human-readable policy label
policy_type NOT NULL nn_governance_policies_type BR-021 Type determines enforcement context
policy_type CHECK chk_governance_policies_type — APPROVAL_THRESHOLD, TOLERANCE, ACCESS, EXCEPTION
effective_from NOT NULL nn_governance_policies_effective_from BR-021 Policy must have effective start
(effective_from, effective_to) CHECK chk_governance_policies_dates effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from — No inverted effective periods
(policy_code, effective_from) UNIQUE uk_governance_policies_code_from BR-021 One version per code per effective date
threshold_value CHECK chk_governance_policies_threshold >= 0 OR NULL BR-021 Thresholds are non-negative
is_active DEFAULT def_governance_policies_is_active = TRUE — Active policy by default

governance.reason_codes

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
reason_code NOT NULL nn_reason_codes_code BR-020 Reason code mandatory on adjustments
reason_code UNIQUE uk_reason_codes_code BR-020 Unique taxonomy key
description NOT NULL nn_reason_codes_description BR-020 Operators must understand reason meaning
category NOT NULL nn_reason_codes_category BR-020 Category drives reporting and analysis
category CHECK chk_reason_codes_category BR-020 Valid adjustment/discrepancy categories
approval_threshold_id FOREIGN KEY fk_reason_codes_policy → governance.governance_policies BR-021 Links to approval threshold when applicable
is_active NOT NULL nn_reason_codes_is_active BR-020 Retired codes must be flagged, not deleted
is_active DEFAULT def_reason_codes_is_active = TRUE BR-020 New codes active by default

Domain 4: Inventory Balance

inventory.stock_positions

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
product_id NOT NULL nn_stock_positions_product_id — Balance must reference a product
product_id FOREIGN KEY fk_stock_positions_product → catalog.products BR-001 Valid catalog product required
location_id NOT NULL nn_stock_positions_location_id — Balance must reference a location
location_id FOREIGN KEY fk_stock_positions_location → network.inventory_locations BR-001 Valid location required
(product_id, location_id) UNIQUE uk_stock_positions_product_location BR-001, LDM-04 One authoritative balance per SKU per site
on_hand_qty NOT NULL nn_stock_positions_on_hand LDM-01 On-hand is mandatory quantity
on_hand_qty DEFAULT def_stock_positions_on_hand = 0 — Zero balance at creation
on_hand_qty CHECK chk_stock_positions_on_hand >= 0 LDM-01 On-hand never negative
reserved_qty NOT NULL nn_stock_positions_reserved BR-002 Reserved quantity always tracked
reserved_qty DEFAULT def_stock_positions_reserved = 0 BR-002 No reservation at creation
reserved_qty CHECK chk_stock_positions_reserved >= 0 BR-002 Reserved cannot be negative
reserved_qty CHECK chk_stock_positions_reserved_le_on_hand reserved_qty <= on_hand_qty BR-002 Cannot reserve more than on-hand
quarantined_qty NOT NULL nn_stock_positions_quarantined BR-013 Quarantined quantity always tracked
quarantined_qty DEFAULT def_stock_positions_quarantined = 0 BR-013 No quarantine at creation
quarantined_qty CHECK chk_stock_positions_quarantined >= 0 BR-013 Quarantine qty non-negative
quarantined_qty CHECK chk_stock_positions_quarantine_le_on_hand quarantined_qty <= on_hand_qty BR-013 Hold cannot exceed on-hand
atp_qty NOT NULL nn_stock_positions_atp BR-001 ATP is mandatory availability measure
atp_qty DEFAULT def_stock_positions_atp = 0 BR-001 Zero ATP at creation
atp_qty CHECK chk_stock_positions_atp >= 0 BR-001 ATP never negative
atp_qty CHECK chk_stock_positions_atp_le_on_hand atp_qty <= on_hand_qty BR-001 ATP cannot exceed on-hand
(on_hand_qty, reserved_qty, quarantined_qty, atp_qty) CHECK chk_stock_positions_atp_formula atp_qty = on_hand_qty - reserved_qty - quarantined_qty BR-001, LDM-01 ATP formula integrity at persistence
inbound_expected_qty NOT NULL nn_stock_positions_inbound_expected BR-005 Pipeline qty tracked separately from ATP
inbound_expected_qty DEFAULT def_stock_positions_inbound_expected = 0 BR-005 Informational only — not ATP
inbound_expected_qty CHECK chk_stock_positions_inbound_expected >= 0 BR-005 Expected inbound non-negative
stock_status NOT NULL nn_stock_positions_status BR-009 Status indicator mandatory
stock_status DEFAULT def_stock_positions_status = 'IN_STOCK' — Default healthy status
stock_status CHECK chk_stock_positions_status IN (IN_STOCK, LOW_STOCK, OUT_OF_STOCK, OVERSTOCK) BR-009 Valid status values
ownership_type NOT NULL nn_stock_positions_ownership BR-031 Ownership classification required
ownership_type DEFAULT def_stock_positions_ownership = 'OWNED' BR-031 Owned stock by default
ownership_type CHECK chk_stock_positions_ownership BR-031, BR-030 OWNED, CONSIGNMENT, BONDED only
version DEFAULT def_stock_positions_version = 1 — Optimistic lock for concurrent reservations

inventory.lot_batches

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
stock_position_id NOT NULL nn_lot_batches_position_id BR-017 Lot belongs to a stock position
stock_position_id FOREIGN KEY fk_lot_batches_position → inventory.stock_positions BR-017 Parent balance must exist
product_id NOT NULL nn_lot_batches_product_id BR-017 Lot scoped to product
product_id FOREIGN KEY fk_lot_batches_product → catalog.products BR-017 Denormalized product for FEFO queries
lot_number NOT NULL nn_lot_batches_lot_number BR-017 Lot identity mandatory for traceable products
(product_id, lot_number, stock_position_id) UNIQUE uk_lot_batches_composite BR-017 One lot row per position
quantity NOT NULL nn_lot_batches_quantity BR-017 Lot quantity required
quantity DEFAULT def_lot_batches_quantity = 0 — Zero at lot creation
quantity CHECK chk_lot_batches_quantity >= 0 LDM-01 Lot quantity non-negative
(expiration_date, manufacture_date) CHECK chk_lot_batches_dates expiration IS NULL OR manufacture IS NULL OR expiration >= manufacture BR-014 Expiration after manufacture
quality_status NOT NULL nn_lot_batches_quality BR-013 Quality status required
quality_status DEFAULT def_lot_batches_quality = 'ACCEPTED' — Accepted at receipt default
quality_status CHECK chk_lot_batches_quality IN (ACCEPTED, HOLD, REJECTED) BR-013 Valid quality states
supplier_id FOREIGN KEY fk_lot_batches_supplier → procurement.suppliers BR-017 Supplier origin for recall traceability

inventory.quarantine_holds

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
hold_reference NOT NULL nn_quarantine_holds_reference BR-013 Hold document identity
hold_reference UNIQUE uk_quarantine_holds_reference BR-013 Unique hold reference
stock_position_id NOT NULL nn_quarantine_holds_position_id BR-013 Hold applied to specific balance
stock_position_id FOREIGN KEY fk_quarantine_holds_position → inventory.stock_positions BR-013 Valid balance required
lot_batch_id FOREIGN KEY fk_quarantine_holds_lot → inventory.lot_batches BR-013 Optional lot-scoped hold
held_qty NOT NULL nn_quarantine_holds_held_qty BR-013 Held quantity mandatory
held_qty CHECK chk_quarantine_holds_held_qty > 0 BR-013 Hold must affect positive quantity
hold_type NOT NULL nn_quarantine_holds_type BR-013, BR-030 Hold classification required
hold_type CHECK chk_quarantine_holds_type BR-013, BR-030 Valid hold types
hold_reason NOT NULL nn_quarantine_holds_reason BR-013 Hold must be justified
hold_status NOT NULL nn_quarantine_holds_status BR-013 Lifecycle state required
hold_status DEFAULT def_quarantine_holds_status = 'ACTIVE' BR-013 Active hold by default
hold_status CHECK chk_quarantine_holds_status IN (ACTIVE, RELEASED, DISPOSED) BR-013 Valid hold lifecycle
hold_start_at NOT NULL nn_quarantine_holds_start BR-013 Hold effective time required
hold_start_at DEFAULT def_quarantine_holds_start = NOW() BR-013 Auto-stamp hold start
(hold_status, released_at) CHECK chk_quarantine_holds_release BR-013 RELEASED status requires released_at
authorized_by FOREIGN KEY fk_quarantine_holds_authorized_by → identity.user_accounts BR-013 Hold authorization attribution

inventory.stock_policies

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
product_id NOT NULL nn_stock_policies_product_id BR-009 Policy scoped to product
product_id FOREIGN KEY fk_stock_policies_product → catalog.products BR-009 Valid product required
location_id NOT NULL nn_stock_policies_location_id BR-009 Policy scoped to location
location_id FOREIGN KEY fk_stock_policies_location → network.inventory_locations BR-009 Valid location required
(product_id, location_id) UNIQUE uk_stock_policies_product_location BR-009, LDM-04 One policy per SKU per site
reorder_level NOT NULL nn_stock_policies_reorder BR-009 Reorder trigger required
reorder_level DEFAULT def_stock_policies_reorder = 0 — Zero default
reorder_level CHECK chk_stock_policies_reorder >= 0 BR-009 Non-negative threshold
minimum_threshold NOT NULL nn_stock_policies_minimum BR-010, BR-012 Minimum floor required
minimum_threshold DEFAULT def_stock_policies_minimum = 0 — Zero default
minimum_threshold CHECK chk_stock_policies_minimum >= 0 BR-010 Non-negative minimum
safety_stock_qty NOT NULL nn_stock_policies_safety BR-010 Safety stock required
safety_stock_qty DEFAULT def_stock_policies_safety = 0 BR-010 Zero default
safety_stock_qty CHECK chk_stock_policies_safety >= 0 BR-010 Safety stock non-negative
(minimum_threshold, reorder_level) CHECK chk_stock_policies_threshold_order minimum_threshold <= reorder_level BR-009, BR-010 Minimum ≤ reorder unless authorized exception
maximum_stock_level CHECK chk_stock_policies_maximum > reorder_level OR NULL — Overstock level above reorder when set
lead_time_days CHECK chk_stock_policies_lead_time > 0 OR NULL — Lead time must be positive
effective_from NOT NULL nn_stock_policies_effective_from BR-009 Effective dating required
effective_from DEFAULT def_stock_policies_effective_from = NOW() — Current timestamp default

inventory.stock_policy_history

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
stock_policy_id NOT NULL nn_stock_policy_history_policy_id BR-009 History belongs to policy
stock_policy_id FOREIGN KEY fk_stock_policy_history_policy → inventory.stock_policies BR-009 Parent policy must exist
reorder_level NOT NULL nn_stock_policy_history_reorder BR-009 Historical value captured
minimum_threshold NOT NULL nn_stock_policy_history_minimum BR-010 Historical value captured
safety_stock_qty NOT NULL nn_stock_policy_history_safety BR-010 Historical value captured
effective_from NOT NULL nn_stock_policy_history_from BR-009 Period start required
effective_to NOT NULL nn_stock_policy_history_to BR-009 Period end required
(effective_from, effective_to) CHECK chk_stock_policy_history_dates effective_to > effective_from BR-009 Valid history window
(stock_policy_id, effective_from) UNIQUE uk_stock_policy_history_policy_from BR-009 Non-overlapping history periods
changed_by FOREIGN KEY fk_stock_policy_history_changed_by → identity.user_accounts BO-19 Change attribution

Domain 5: Procurement

procurement.suppliers

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
supplier_code NOT NULL nn_suppliers_code BR-007 Vendor code mandatory
supplier_code UNIQUE uk_suppliers_code BR-007 Unique commercial counterparty
supplier_name NOT NULL nn_suppliers_name BR-007 Vendor must be identifiable
payment_terms_days NOT NULL nn_suppliers_payment_terms BR-008 Payment terms required before PO
payment_terms_days DEFAULT def_suppliers_payment_terms = 30 — Standard net-30 default
payment_terms_days CHECK chk_suppliers_payment_terms > 0 BR-008 Positive payment terms
is_consignment NOT NULL nn_suppliers_is_consignment BR-031 Consignment flag explicit
is_consignment DEFAULT def_suppliers_is_consignment = FALSE BR-031 Standard purchase by default
delivery_rating CHECK chk_suppliers_rating BETWEEN 0 AND 5 OR NULL — Valid rating scale
default_lead_time_days CHECK chk_suppliers_lead_time > 0 OR NULL — Positive lead time when set

procurement.purchase_requisitions

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
requisition_number NOT NULL nn_purchase_requisitions_number BR-009 Internal document identity
requisition_number UNIQUE uk_purchase_requisitions_number — Unique requisition reference
requesting_location_id NOT NULL nn_purchase_requisitions_location BR-009 Replenishment destination required
requesting_location_id FOREIGN KEY fk_purchase_requisitions_location → network.inventory_locations BR-009 Valid receiving site
approval_status NOT NULL nn_purchase_requisitions_status BR-009 Workflow state required
approval_status DEFAULT def_purchase_requisitions_status = 'DRAFT' — Starts as draft
approval_status CHECK chk_purchase_requisitions_status IN (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CONVERTED) BR-009 Valid approval states
(approval_status, approved_by) CHECK chk_purchase_requisitions_approval BR-021 APPROVED requires approver
triggering_alert_id FOREIGN KEY fk_purchase_requisitions_alert → audit.operational_alerts BR-009 Alert-to-requisition traceability
approved_by FOREIGN KEY fk_purchase_requisitions_approved_by → identity.user_accounts BR-021 Approver attribution
purchase_order_id FOREIGN KEY fk_purchase_requisitions_po → procurement.purchase_orders BR-009 PO conversion link
created_by NOT NULL nn_purchase_requisitions_created_by BO-19 Initiator required
created_by FOREIGN KEY fk_purchase_requisitions_created_by → identity.user_accounts BO-19 Initiator attribution

procurement.purchase_requisition_lines

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
requisition_id NOT NULL nn_purchase_requisition_lines_req_id — Line belongs to requisition
requisition_id FOREIGN KEY fk_purchase_requisition_lines_req → procurement.purchase_requisitions — Parent document exists
line_number NOT NULL nn_purchase_requisition_lines_line — Line sequence required
line_number CHECK chk_purchase_requisition_lines_line > 0 — Positive line numbers
(requisition_id, line_number) UNIQUE uk_purchase_requisition_lines_req_line — Unique line per requisition
product_id NOT NULL nn_purchase_requisition_lines_product BR-027 Product required
product_id FOREIGN KEY fk_purchase_requisition_lines_product → catalog.products BR-027 Active product validation at application layer
requested_qty NOT NULL nn_purchase_requisition_lines_qty BR-009 Quantity required
requested_qty CHECK chk_purchase_requisition_lines_qty > 0 BR-009 Positive requested quantity

procurement.purchase_orders

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
po_number NOT NULL nn_purchase_orders_number BR-007 PO document identity
po_number UNIQUE uk_purchase_orders_number BR-007 Unique authorization document
supplier_id NOT NULL nn_purchase_orders_supplier BR-007 PO requires supplier
supplier_id FOREIGN KEY fk_purchase_orders_supplier → procurement.suppliers BR-007 Valid active supplier
receiving_location_id NOT NULL nn_purchase_orders_location BR-007 Receiving site required
receiving_location_id FOREIGN KEY fk_purchase_orders_location → network.inventory_locations BR-007 Valid receiving location
order_date NOT NULL nn_purchase_orders_order_date BR-007 PO date mandatory
po_status NOT NULL nn_purchase_orders_status BR-007 PO lifecycle state
po_status DEFAULT def_purchase_orders_status = 'OPEN' BR-007 New POs open
po_status CHECK chk_purchase_orders_status BR-007 OPEN, PARTIAL, CLOSED, CANCELLED
total_commitment_amount NOT NULL nn_purchase_orders_total BR-008 Financial commitment tracked
total_commitment_amount DEFAULT def_purchase_orders_total = 0 — Zero until lines added
total_commitment_amount CHECK chk_purchase_orders_total >= 0 BR-008 Non-negative commitment
currency_code NOT NULL nn_purchase_orders_currency BR-008 Currency required
currency_code DEFAULT def_purchase_orders_currency = 'USD' — Default currency
currency_code CHECK chk_purchase_orders_currency length = 3 — ISO 4217 format
payment_terms_days NOT NULL nn_purchase_orders_terms BR-008 Terms on PO
payment_terms_days DEFAULT def_purchase_orders_terms = 30 — Default net-30
created_by NOT NULL nn_purchase_orders_created_by BO-19 Buyer attribution
created_by FOREIGN KEY fk_purchase_orders_created_by → identity.user_accounts BO-19 Buyer identity

procurement.purchase_order_lines

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
purchase_order_id NOT NULL nn_purchase_order_lines_po_id BR-007 Line belongs to PO
purchase_order_id FOREIGN KEY fk_purchase_order_lines_po → procurement.purchase_orders BR-007 Parent PO exists

qty_before CHECK chk_movement_records_before >= 0 LDM-01 Non-negative before
qty_after NOT NULL nn_movement_records_after BO-19 After snapshot
qty_after CHECK chk_movement_records_after >= 0 LDM-01 Non-negative after
(qty_before, qty_after, quantity_change) CHECK chk_movement_records_balance qty_after = qty_before + quantity_change BO-19 Movement arithmetic integrity
lot_batch_id FOREIGN KEY fk_movement_records_lot → inventory.lot_batches BR-017 Lot on traceable movements
reason_code_id FOREIGN KEY fk_movement_records_reason → governance.reason_codes BR-020 Reason on adjustment movements
source_document_type NOT NULL nn_movement_records_source_type BO-19 Origin document type
source_document_id NOT NULL nn_movement_records_source_id BO-19 Origin document PK
performed_by NOT NULL nn_movement_records_user BO-19 User attribution
performed_by FOREIGN KEY fk_movement_records_user → identity.user_accounts BO-19 Valid user
movement_timestamp NOT NULL nn_movement_records_timestamp BO-19 Event time — partition key
movement_timestamp DEFAULT def_movement_records_timestamp = NOW() BO-19 Auto-stamp event time

audit.audit_trail_records

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification

(audit_event_reference, event_timestamp) UNIQUE uk_audit_trail_ref_ts BO-19 Unique event per partition
affected_entity_type NOT NULL nn_audit_trail_entity_type BO-19 Entity type required
affected_entity_id NOT NULL nn_audit_trail_entity_id BO-19 Entity PK required

user_id FOREIGN KEY fk_audit_trail_user → identity.user_accounts BO-19 Valid user
movement_record_id FOREIGN KEY fk_audit_trail_movement → audit.inventory_movement_records BO-19 Links to operational movement

audit.operational_alerts

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
alert_reference NOT NULL nn_operational_alerts_ref BR-009, BR-032 Alert document identity
alert_reference UNIQUE uk_operational_alerts_ref — Unique alert reference

severity NOT NULL nn_operational_alerts_severity BR-032 Priority required
severity DEFAULT def_operational_alerts_severity = 'MEDIUM' BR-032 Medium default
severity CHECK chk_operational_alerts_severity IN (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL) BR-032 Valid severity levels
product_id FOREIGN KEY fk_operational_alerts_product → catalog.products BR-009 Alert context SKU
location_id FOREIGN KEY fk_operational_alerts_location → network.inventory_locations BR-009 Alert context site
stock_position_id FOREIGN KEY fk_operational_alerts_position → inventory.stock_positions BR-009 Threshold breach source
acknowledgment_status NOT NULL nn_operational_alerts_ack BR-009 Acknowledgment tracking
acknowledgment_status DEFAULT def_operational_alerts_ack = 'OPEN' BR-009 Open until acknowledged
acknowledgment_status CHECK chk_operational_alerts_ack IN (OPEN, ACKNOWLEDGED, RESOLVED) BR-009 Valid ack states
resolution_status NOT NULL nn_operational_alerts_resolution BR-009 Resolution tracking
resolution_status DEFAULT def_operational_alerts_resolution = 'PENDING' BR-009 Pending by default
resolution_status CHECK chk_operational_alerts_resolution IN (PENDING, RESOLVED, DISMISSED) BR-009 Valid resolution states
alert_date NOT NULL nn_operational_alerts_date BR-009 Alert creation time
alert_date DEFAULT def_operational_alerts_date = NOW() BR-009 Auto-stamp alert
(resolution_status, resolved_at) CHECK chk_operational_alerts_resolved BR-009 RESOLVED requires resolved_at

audit.inventory_valuation_snapshots

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
snapshot_reference NOT NULL nn_valuation_snapshots_ref BR-008, BR-031 Snapshot document identity
snapshot_reference UNIQUE uk_valuation_snapshots_ref — Unique snapshot reference
valuation_date NOT NULL nn_valuation_snapshots_date BR-031 As-of date required
location_scope NOT NULL nn_valuation_snapshots_scope BR-031 Scope classification
location_scope CHECK chk_valuation_snapshots_scope IN (SINGLE, REGION, NETWORK) BR-031 Valid scope values
(valuation_date, location_scope) UNIQUE uk_valuation_snapshots_date_scope BR-031 One snapshot per period per scope
total_inventory_value NOT NULL nn_valuation_snapshots_total BR-031 Total value required
total_inventory_value CHECK chk_valuation_snapshots_total >= 0 BR-031 Non-negative total
owned_value NOT NULL nn_valuation_snapshots_owned BR-031 Owned value required

prepared_by NOT NULL nn_valuation_snapshots_prepared_by BO-19 Preparer attribution
prepared_by FOREIGN KEY fk_valuation_snapshots_prepared_by → identity.user_accounts BO-19 Valid user

audit.inventory_valuation_lines

Column Type Constraint Business Rule Justification
snapshot_id NOT NULL nn_valuation_lines_snapshot BR-031 Line belongs to snapshot

quantity CHECK chk_valuation_lines_qty >= 0 BR-031 Non-negative snapshot qty
