Document ID: SRS-API-001 | Version 1.0 | July 6, 2026

Complete API Specification

Inventory Management System

Document Information

Attribute Detail
Document ID SRS-API-009
Document Title Complete REST API Specification
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Senior Backend Architect
Source Documents SRS-API-001 through SRS-API-008
Date July 6, 2026
Base URL https://{host}/api/v1
Scope All 178 REST endpoints — full contract per endpoint

Purpose

Single authoritative specification combining HTTP contract, validation, authorization, business rules, and examples for every IMS REST API.

Specification Template (18 Fields)

Every endpoint section uses fields 1–18 in identical order. Cross-references: Request detail → SRS-API-002/004; Response shapes → SRS-API-003; Errors → SRS-API-005; Auth → SRS-API-007; Collection queries → SRS-API-006.

Global Conventions

Standard Request Headers

Header Required Applies To Description
Authorization Yes* All except API-175 Bearer {access_token} from IdP (SVC-01)
Content-Type Yes POST/PATCH/PUT with body application/json
Accept Recommended All application/json
X-Trace-Id Optional All Client correlation UUID; echoed in errors
Idempotency-Key Recommended Stock mutation, reservation, payment commands UUID; 24h deduplication window
X-API-Major-Version Optional All Client-declared major version (default 1)

* API-176–178 use OAuth2 Client Credentials (Authorization: Bearer {client_token}).

Standard Success Headers

Header Description
X-API-Version Contract release e.g. 1.0.0
X-Trace-Id Server trace ID
Location On 201 Created — URI of created resource
ETag On mutable resources — optimistic lock version

Standard Error Responses (All Endpoints)

Content-Type: application/problem+json

HTTP When Typical errorCode
400 Validation failure VAL_REQUEST_INVALID, VAL_REQUIRED_FIELD
401 Missing/invalid auth AUTH_MISSING_CREDENTIALS, AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED
403 Permission or location scope denied AUTHZ_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION, AUTHZ_LOCATION_SCOPE_DENIED
404 Resource not found NF_* per resource type
409 Duplicate, state conflict, optimistic lock CONF_*
422 Business rule violation BIZ_*
500 Unhandled error SYS_INTERNAL_ERROR
503 Dependency unavailable SYS_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE

Standard error body (reference for all APIs):

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/validation-error",
  "title": "Validation Failed",
  "status": 400,
  "detail": "The request contains validation errors.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/{path}",
  "errorCode": "VAL_REQUEST_INVALID",
  "traceId": "7f3c9a2e-4b1d-4e8a-9c0f-2a8b6d4e1f30",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T14:30:00.000Z",
  "errors": [{ "field": "fieldName", "code": "VAL_REQUIRED_FIELD", "message": "..." }]
}

Standard Pagination Query (Collection GETs)

Parameter Type Default Max Description
page integer 1 — 1-based page index
pageSize integer 20 100 Records per page

See SRS-API-006 for endpoint-specific filters, sort, and search parameters.

M-01 — Product Catalog

API-001: Register Product

# Field Value
1 HTTP Method POST
2 URL /api/v1/products
3 Purpose Register a new product SKU with mandatory catalog attributes
4 Authentication Required — Bearer JWT
5 Required Permission PERM-001 (Create Product) — Role: INV_CTRL
6 Request Headers Authorization, Content-Type: application/json, optional X-Trace-Id
7 Path Parameters None
8 Query Parameters None
9 Request Body CreateProductRequest — sku, name, unitOfMeasure (required); description, categoryCode, barcode, isTraceable, rotationPolicy, shelfLifeManaged, mrslThresholdDays (optional/conditional)
10 Validation Rules sku 1–50, pattern ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$, unique (VR-001, VR-002); name 1–200 non-blank; unitOfMeasure 1–10; if isTraceable=true → rotationPolicy required; if shelfLifeManaged=true → mrslThresholdDays ≥1 (VR-035)
11 Success Response ProductDetailResponse — full product with audit
12 Error Responses 400 validation; 401 auth; 403 INV_CTRL only; 409 CONF_DUPLICATE_SKU; 422 discontinued rules N/A on create
13 HTTP Status Codes Success: 201 Created; Errors: 400, 401, 403, 409, 500
14 Business Rules Applied BR-014, BR-015, BR-016, BR-017 (traceability attributes at definition)
15 Related Use Case UC-001, UC-046

16. Example Request

POST /api/v1/products HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIs...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "sku": "BOLT-M10",
  "name": "M10 Hex Bolt",
  "unitOfMeasure": "EA",
  "categoryCode": "FAST",
  "isTraceable": false
}

17. Example Success Response — 201 Created

{
  "sku": "BOLT-M10",
  "name": "M10 Hex Bolt",
  "lifecycleStatus": "ACTIVE",
  "abcClass": null,
  "unitOfMeasure": "EA",
  "description": null,
  "categoryCode": "FAST",
  "barcode": null,
  "isTraceable": false,
  "rotationPolicy": "FIFO",
  "shelfLifeManaged": false,
  "mrslThresholdDays": null,
  "audit": {
    "createdAt": "2026-07-06T14:00:00.000Z",
    "createdBy": "inv.controller",
    "updatedAt": "2026-07-06T14:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedBy": "inv.controller"
  }
}

18. Example Error Response — 409 Conflict

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/conflict",
  "title": "Resource Conflict",
  "status": 409,
  "detail": "A product with SKU 'BOLT-M10' already exists in the catalog.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/products",
  "errorCode": "CONF_DUPLICATE_SKU",
  "traceId": "f7a8b9c0-1234-5678-9012-def012345678",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T14:01:00.000Z",
  "validationRuleId": "VR-002"
}

API-002: Search Products

# Field Value
1 HTTP Method GET
2 URL /api/v1/products
3 Purpose Search and filter products by name, category, status, ABC class
4 Authentication Required — Bearer JWT
5 Required Permission PERM-004 (Lookup Product)
6 Request Headers Authorization, optional Accept
7 Path Parameters None
8 Query Parameters name (partial), sku (prefix), categoryCode, lifecycleStatus, abcClass, barcode, q (search name/sku/barcode), page, pageSize, sortBy (sku,name,categoryCode,lifecycleStatus), sortDirection (ASC,DESC)
9 Request Body None
10 Validation Rules page≥1; pageSize 1–100; valid enums for status/ABC; sortBy whitelist (VR-054)
11 Success Response PagedResponse<ProductSummaryResponse>
12 Error Responses 400 invalid query; 401; 403
13 HTTP Status Codes Success: 200 OK
14 Business Rules Applied BR-027 (filter by discontinued via lifecycleStatus)
15 Related Use Case UC-001, UC-013

16. Example Request

GET /api/v1/products?lifecycleStatus=ACTIVE&page=1&pageSize=20&sortBy=sku HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIs...

17. Example Success Response — 200 OK

{
  "data": [
    { "sku": "BOLT-M10", "name": "M10 Hex Bolt", "lifecycleStatus": "ACTIVE", "abcClass": "B", "unitOfMeasure": "EA" }
  ],
  "page": 1,
  "pageSize": 20,
  "totalElements": 1,
  "totalPages": 1
}

18. Example Error Response — 400 Bad Request

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/validation-error",
  "title": "Validation Failed",
  "status": 400,
  "detail": "Invalid sortBy value.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/products",
  "errorCode": "VAL_INVALID_ENUM",
  "traceId": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T14:05:00.000Z",
  "errors": [{ "field": "sortBy", "code": "VAL_INVALID_ENUM", "message": "sortBy must be one of: sku, name, categoryCode, lifecycleStatus" }]
}

4 Authentication Required

API-004: Update Product Attributes

# Field Value
1 HTTP Method PATCH
2 URL /api/v1/products/{sku}
3 Purpose Update mutable product attributes
4 Authentication Required
5 Required Permission PERM-002 — INV_CTRL
6 Request Headers Authorization, Content-Type, optional If-Match (ETag)

9 Request Body UpdateProductAttributesRequest — at least one of: name, description, unitOfMeasure, categoryCode, barcode, isTraceable, rotationPolicy, shelfLifeManaged, mrslThresholdDays

13 HTTP Status Codes 200 OK

15 Related Use Case UC-001

16–18: PATCH body with name update; 200 returns updated ProductDetailResponse; 400 if empty body (VAL_PATCH_NO_FIELDS).

API-005: Change Product Lifecycle Status

# Field Value
1 HTTP Method POST
2 URL /api/v1/products/{sku}/lifecycle-status
3 Purpose Change lifecycle status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, DISCONTINUED)
4 Authentication Required
5 Required Permission PERM-003 — INV_CTRL
6 Request Headers Authorization, Content-Type
7 Path Parameters sku
8 Query Parameters None
9 Request Body newStatus (required), reason (optional), effectiveDate (optional)
10 Validation Rules Valid status transition VR-004, VR-005; reason max 500
11 Success Response CommandResultResponse + embedded ProductDetailResponse
12 Error Responses 400; 403; 404; 422 invalid transition
13 HTTP Status Codes 200 OK
14 Business Rules Applied BR-027 (DISCONTINUED blocks replenishment)
15 Related Use Case UC-001

16. Example Request

{ "newStatus": "DISCONTINUED", "reason": "Supplier end-of-life", "effectiveDate": "2026-07-15" }

17. Example Success: { "id": "BOLT-M10", "status": "DISCONTINUED", "processedAt": "2026-07-06T14:10:00.000Z", "message": "Lifecycle status updated." }
18. Example Error: 422 BIZ_PRODUCT_DISCONTINUED / invalid transition per VR-005.

# Field Value
1 HTTP Method PUT

3 Purpose Assign or update ABC priority classification
4 Authentication Required

6 Request Headers Authorization, Content-Type

Complete API Specification — Part 3

M-08 through Platform (API-098 – API-178)

Parent document: Complete-API-Specification.md (SRS-API-009)
Conventions: Global headers, errors, and pagination apply from Part 1. All URLs are prefixed with /api/v1.

M-08 — Network Transfer

API-098: Request Stock Transfer

# Field Value
1 HTTP Method POST
2 URL /api/v1/transfers
3 Purpose Request inter-location stock transfer to resolve local shortage
4 Authentication Required — Bearer JWT
5 Required Permission PERM-071 — OPS_DIR, WH_MGR, REG_MGR
6 Request Headers Authorization, Content-Type: application/json, optional Idempotency-Key, X-Trace-Id
7 Path Parameters None
8 Query Parameters None
9 Request Body sourceLocationCode, destinationLocationCode, justification, lines[] (sku, requestedQuantity); optional priority, requiredByDate
10 Validation Rules VR-128–VR-130; source ≠ destination; qty ≤ source ATP; respects source minimum (VR-140)
11 Success Response StockTransferDetailResponse — transferId, status: REQUESTED, lines, audit
12 Error Responses 400 validation; 401; 403 location scope; 422 BIZ_INSUFFICIENT_ATP, BIZ_SOURCE_MINIMUM_BREACH
13 HTTP Status Codes Success: 201 Created; Errors: 400, 401, 403, 422, 500
14 Business Rules Applied BR-011, BR-012
15 Related Use Case UC-031

16. Example Request

POST /api/v1/transfers HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer eyJ...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "sourceLocationCode": "WH-WEST",
  "destinationLocationCode": "WH-EAST",
  "justification": "East warehouse below safety stock for BOLT-M10",
  "lines": [{ "sku": "BOLT-M10", "requestedQuantity": { "amount": 50, "unitOfMeasure": "EA" } }]
}

17. Example Success — 201

{
  "transferId": "TRF-2026-0042",
  "status": "REQUESTED",
  "sourceLocationCode": "WH-WEST",
  "destinationLocationCode": "WH-EAST",
  "lines": [{ "sku": "BOLT-M10", "requestedQuantity": { "amount": 50, "unitOfMeasure": "EA" }, "approvedQuantity": null }]
}

18. Example Error — 422

{
  "status": 422,
  "errorCode": "BIZ_SOURCE_MINIMUM_BREACH",
  "businessRuleId": "BR-012",
  "detail": "Transfer would reduce WH-WEST below minimum stock level."
}

Request DTO Specification

Inventory Management System

Document Information

Attribute Detail
Document ID SRS-API-002
Document Title Request DTO Specification — Inventory Management System
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Backend Architect
Source Documents SRS-API-001 (REST API Catalog), SRS-VR-001 (Validation Rules), SRS-DM-002 (Value Objects), SRS-DB (Database Design)
Date July 6, 2026
Scope Request DTOs only — path parameters, query parameters, and request bodies. Response DTOs are out of scope.

Purpose

This document defines the request data transfer object for every REST API in SRS-API-001. Each field specifies name, data type, required/optional status, validation rules, and business description. Validation rule references use VR-xxx from SRS-VR-001 and BR-xxx from the Business Rule Catalog where applicable.

Request Composition Conventions

Layer Convention
Path parameters Included in every applicable API's Request DTO
Query parameters Used for GET list, search, and filter operations
Request body Used for POST, PUT, PATCH command operations
Headers Authorization: Bearer <token> required on all APIs except API-175; not repeated per DTO
Idempotency Optional Idempotency-Key header (UUID) on financial and reservation commands — documented per API where recommended

Shared Primitive Types

Type Java/Spring Mapping Validation
ProductSku String Required when present; max 50 chars; pattern ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$ (VR-001, VR-007)
LocationCode String Required when present; max 30 chars; pattern ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$ (VR-011)
SupplierCode String Required when present; max 30 chars; pattern ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$
ReasonCode String Required when present; max 20 chars; must reference active reason code (VR-026, VR-027)
Quantity BigDecimal Scale ≤ 4; min 0 (VR-018, VR-023, VR-070)
PositiveQuantity BigDecimal Scale ≤ 4; min exclusive 0 (VR-032, VR-035, VR-066)
CurrencyCode String ISO 4217; exactly 3 uppercase letters
LocalDate LocalDate ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD
Instant Instant ISO-8601 UTC datetime
Uuid UUID RFC 4122 format
AbcClass String Enum: A, B, C (VR-021)
LifecycleStatus String Enum: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, DISCONTINUED (VR-004–VR-006)
PageNumber Integer Min 1; default 1
PageSize Integer Min 1; max 100; default 20

Shared Nested DTOs

Reused across multiple API request bodies.

PaginationQuery (query)

Field Type Required Validation Rules Description
page Integer Optional Min 1; default 1 Page number for paginated results
pageSize Integer Optional Min 1; max 100; default 20 Number of records per page
sortBy String Optional Max 50 chars; allowed values per resource Sort field name
sortDirection String Optional Enum: ASC, DESC; default ASC Sort direction

DateRangeQuery (query)

Field Type Required Validation Rules Description
startDate LocalDate Required Valid date; on or before endDate (VR-062, VR-153) Period start (inclusive)
endDate LocalDate Required Valid date; on or after startDate Period end (inclusive)

QuantityDto (body)

Field Type Required Validation Rules Description
amount BigDecimal Required Scale ≤ 4; min 0 Numeric quantity amount
unitOfMeasure String Required Max 10 chars; must match product UoM or approved alternate Unit of measure code

PositiveQuantityDto (body)

Field Type Required Validation Rules Description
amount BigDecimal Required Scale ≤ 4; min exclusive 0 (VR-032) Numeric quantity greater than zero
unitOfMeasure String Required Max 10 chars Unit of measure code

LotIdentityDto (body)

Field Type Required Validation Rules Description
lotNumber String Required Max 50 chars; non-blank (BR-017) Lot or batch identifier
expirationDate LocalDate Optional Future or present when product is shelf-life managed Lot expiration date for FEFO

ShelfLifeProfileDto (body)

Field Type Required Validation Rules Description
expirationDate LocalDate Required Valid date; remaining life must meet MRSL (BR-016, VR-035) Product expiration date at receipt
manufactureDate LocalDate Optional On or before expirationDate Manufacture date when available

Response DTO Specification

Inventory Management System

Document Information

Attribute Detail
Document ID SRS-API-003
Document Title Response DTO Specification — Inventory Management System
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Senior Backend Architect
Source Documents SRS-API-001 (REST API Catalog), SRS-API-002 (Request DTOs), SRS-VR-001, SRS-DM-002
Date July 6, 2026
Scope Success response DTOs only — error responses follow RFC 7807 Problem Details (separate contract)

Purpose

Defines the success response structure for every REST API in SRS-API-001: HTTP status code, response fields, nested objects, and example JSON. Naming aligns with SRS-API-002 request DTOs.

HTTP Status Code Conventions

Operation Success Status Response Body
POST — resource creation 201 Created Created resource or creation result
GET — single resource 200 OK Resource detail
GET — collection / search 200 OK Paginated or array wrapper
PATCH / PUT 200 OK Updated resource
POST — command / action 200 OK Command result with updated state
DELETE 200 OK Revocation result (or 204 No Content when no body — IMS uses 200 with body for traceability)

Shared Response Wrappers

PagedResponse<T>

Field Type Description
data Array<T> Page of result items
page Integer Current page number (1-based)
pageSize Integer Page size
totalElements Long Total matching records
totalPages Integer Total pages

CommandResultResponse

Used by approve, reject, cancel, acknowledge, and similar action endpoints.

Field Type Description
id UUID Affected resource identifier
status String New resource status after command
processedAt Instant Command processing timestamp
message String Optional human-readable confirmation

AuditInfoResponse

Field Type Description
createdAt Instant Record creation timestamp
createdBy String Creating user ID
updatedAt Instant Last update timestamp
updatedBy String Last updating user ID

Shared Nested Response Objects

QuantityResponse

Field Type Description
amount BigDecimal Quantity amount
unitOfMeasure String UoM code

MonetaryAmountResponse

Field Type Description
amount BigDecimal Monetary value
currencyCode String ISO 4217 currency

LotIdentityResponse

Field Type Description
lotNumber String Lot/batch number
expirationDate LocalDate Expiration date

StockAvailabilityResponse

Field Type Description
onHand QuantityResponse Physical on-hand quantity
reserved QuantityResponse Reserved quantity
quarantined QuantityResponse Quarantined quantity
atp QuantityResponse Available-to-promise
ownershipType String OWNED or CONSIGNMENT

AddressResponse

Field Type Description
line1 String Address line 1
line2 String Address line 2
city String City
stateProvince String State or province
postalCode String Postal code
countryCode String ISO country code

ProductSummaryResponse

Field Type Description
sku String Product SKU
name String Product name
lifecycleStatus String ACTIVE, INACTIVE, DISCONTINUED
abcClass String A, B, C, or null
unitOfMeasure String Primary UoM

ProductDetailResponse (extends summary)

Field Type Description
(all ProductSummaryResponse fields)
description String Product description
categoryCode String Category code
barcode String Primary barcode
isTraceable Boolean Lot/batch required
rotationPolicy String FIFO or FEFO
shelfLifeManaged Boolean MRSL applies
mrslThresholdDays Integer MRSL threshold days
audit AuditInfoResponse Audit metadata

LocationSummaryResponse

Field Type Description
locationCode String Location code
name String Location name
locationType String Location type enum
operationalStatus String Operational status
parentLocationCode String Parent location code

EligibilityResponse

Field Type Description
eligible Boolean Whether transaction is permitted
transactionType String Evaluated transaction type
reason String Ineligibility reason when eligible=false
lifecycleStatus String Current product lifecycle status

Attribute Value
HTTP Status 201 Created
Response DTO ProductDetailResponse
Nested Objects AuditInfoResponse

Example:

{

  "lifecycleStatus": "ACTIVE",
  "abcClass": null,

  "categoryCode": "HARDW",

  "rotationPolicy": "FIFO",
  "shelfLifeManaged": false,
  "mrslThresholdDays": null,

    "createdAt": "2026-07-06T14:30:00Z",
    "createdBy": "usr-inv-ctrl-01",
    "updatedAt": "2026-07-06T14:30:00Z",
    "updatedBy": "usr-inv-ctrl-01"
  }
}

Attribute Value
HTTP Status 200 OK

Field Type Description

Example:

API-010 — POST /api/v1/products/import

Attribute Value
HTTP Status 200 OK
Response DTO BulkImportResultResponse
Field Type Description
importMode String Import mode executed
totalRecords Integer Records processed
successCount Integer Successfully imported
failureCount Integer Failed records
errors Array<ImportErrorResponse> Per-record errors

ImportErrorResponse: rowIndex (Integer), sku (String), errorCode (String), message (String)

Example:

{
  "importMode": "UPSERT",
  "totalRecords": 100,
  "successCount": 98,
  "failureCount": 2,
  "errors": [
    {
      "rowIndex": 15,
      "sku": "SKU-DUP-001",
      "errorCode": "DUPLICATE_SKU",
      "message": "SKU already exists"
    }
  ]
}

Request DTO Validation Specification

Inventory Management System

Document Information

Attribute Detail
Document ID SRS-API-004
Document Title Request DTO Validation Specification
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Senior Backend Architect
Source Documents SRS-API-002 (Request DTOs), SRS-VR-001 (Validation Rules), SRS-BR-001 (Business Rules)
Date July 6, 2026
Scope Input validation for all Request DTOs — success-path only; error contract is RFC 7807

Purpose

Defines enforceable validation for every Request DTO field across all 178 REST APIs. Each constraint is classified as required, length, format, business, or cross-field validation and traced to BR-xxx (business rule) and/or VR-xxx (validation rule).

Coverage Summary

Module API Range DTOs Validation Depth
M-01 Product Catalog API-001 – API-010 10 Field matrix + profiles
M-02 Warehouse Network API-011 – API-021 11 Field matrix + profiles
M-03 Inventory Governance API-022 – API-031 10 Validation profiles
M-04 Inventory Balance API-032 – API-048 17 Validation profiles
M-05 Procurement & Supplier API-049 – API-065 17 Validation profiles
M-06 Inbound Receiving API-066 – API-080 15 Validation profiles
M-07 Order Fulfillment API-081 – API-097 17 Validation profiles
M-08 Network Transfer API-098 – API-107 10 Validation profiles

M-10 Returns Management API-124 – API-131 8 Validation profiles
M-11 Commercial Campaign API-132 – API-139 8 Validation profiles
M-12 Identity & Access API-140 – API-149 10 Validation profiles
M-13 Inventory Intelligence API-150 – API-172 23 Query validation profiles
Platform & Integration API-173 – API-178 6 Validation profiles
Total API-001 – API-178 178 —

Validation Execution Layers

Layer Responsibility Examples
L1 — Structural Required, length, format, enum @NotBlank, @Size, @Pattern, @DecimalMin
L2 — Referential FK existence, catalog lookup Product exists, location active
L3 — Business Domain invariants, BR enforcement ATP check, SoD check, freeze guard
L4 — Cross-field Multi-field logic startDate ≤ endDate, PO or ad-hoc auth

L1–L2 run at API/presentation boundary; L3–L4 run in application/domain services.

Validation Matrix Legend

Column Meaning
Req R=Required, O=Optional, C=Conditional
Length Max/min character or numeric bounds
Format Pattern, enum, ISO type
Business Validation L2/L3 domain checks
Cross-Field L4 dependencies
BR Business rule ID(s)
VR Validation rule ID(s)

Shared Primitive Validation

Primitive Req Length Format Business Validation Cross-Field BR VR
ProductSku R when present 1–50 chars ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$ Must exist in catalog when mutating stock — — VR-001, VR-002, VR-007

Document ID: SRS-API-004 | Version 1.0 | July 6, 2026

Error Response Specification

Inventory Management System

Document Information

Attribute Detail
Document ID SRS-API-005
Document Title Standard Error Response Model — Inventory Management System
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Senior Backend Architect
Source Documents SRS-API-001, SRS-API-004, SRS-BR-001, SRS-VR-001, Cross-Cutting Concerns (Exception Handling)
Date July 6, 2026
Scope All REST APIs under /api/v1

Purpose

Defines the standard error response contract for every REST API. All error responses conform to RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs with IMS extensions for machine-readable error codes, field-level validation, business rule traceability, and operational correlation.

Design Principles

Principle Detail
RFC 7807 baseline type, title, status, detail, instance on every response
Machine + human errorCode for clients/automation; detail / message for operators
No leakage 500 responses never expose stack traces, SQL, or internal paths
Traceability traceId on every error; businessRuleId / validationRuleId when applicable
Layer mapping Presentation maps domain/application exceptions — domain never emits HTTP codes

Standard Envelope

ProblemDetailResponse (base)

Field Type Required Description
type String (URI) Yes Problem type URI — stable identifier for error category
title String Yes Short, human-readable summary of the problem type
status Integer Yes HTTP status code (duplicate of response status for convenience)
detail String Yes Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence
instance String (URI) Yes Request path that triggered the error (e.g. /api/v1/products)
errorCode String Yes IMS machine-readable error code (see naming convention)
traceId String (UUID) Yes Distributed trace / correlation ID for support and logs
timestamp String (Instant) Yes ISO-8601 UTC time the error was generated
details Object No Structured context — shape varies by error category
errors Array<FieldError> No Field-level validation errors (400 only)

FieldError (validation extension)

Field Type Required Description
field String Yes JSON path to the invalid field (e.g. lines[2].quantity.amount)
code String Yes Field-level validation error code
message String Yes Human-readable field error
rejectedValue Any No Submitted value when safe to return (omit secrets)

Problem Type URI Convention

https://api.{environment}.ims.example/problems/{category}
Category slug HTTP Status Used for
validation-error 400 Request syntactic / structural validation
authentication-error 401 Missing or invalid credentials
authorization-error 403 Authenticated but not permitted
not-found 404 Resource does not exist or not visible
conflict 409 State conflict, duplicate, concurrency
business-rule-violation 422 Domain business rule or invariant failure
internal-server-error 500 Unexpected unhandled failure
service-unavailable 503 Infrastructure / dependency unavailable

Error Code Naming Convention

{CATEGORY}_{DOMAIN}_{REASON}
Prefix Category
VAL_ Validation (400)
AUTH_ Authentication (401)
AUTHZ_ Authorization (403)
NF_ Not Found (404)
CONF_ Conflict (409)
BIZ_ Business rule (422)
SYS_ System / internal (500, 503)

Error Category Catalog

1. Validation Errors — 400 Bad Request

When: Request fails syntactic validation (L1–L2) before or during command dispatch. Bean Validation, FluentValidation, or request binder failures.

Attribute Value
HTTP Status Code 400
Problem Type https://api.ims.example/problems/validation-error
Exception Source ValidationException (Presentation / Application)

Standard Error Codes

Error Code Error Message (title/detail pattern) Trigger
VAL_REQUEST_INVALID The request contains one or more validation errors. Generic wrapper when multiple field errors
VAL_REQUIRED_FIELD Required field is missing or blank. @NotNull, @NotBlank
VAL_INVALID_FORMAT Field value does not match the required format. Pattern, type coercion failure
VAL_OUT_OF_RANGE Value is outside the allowed range. Min/max, scale violations
VAL_INVALID_ENUM Value is not a permitted enumeration member. Unknown enum value
VAL_INVALID_DATE_RANGE Start date must be on or before end date. Cross-field date (VR-062, VR-153)
VAL_PATCH_NO_FIELDS At least one field must be provided for update. Empty PATCH body
VAL_QUERY_FILTER_REQUIRED At least one filter parameter is required. e.g. sku OR locationCode (VR-054)

Details Object Shape

{
  "details": {
    "requestId": "optional-client-correlation"
  }
}

Example JSON Response

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/validation-error",
  "title": "Validation Failed",
  "status": 400,
  "detail": "The request contains 2 validation errors. Correct the highlighted fields and resubmit.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/products",
  "errorCode": "VAL_REQUEST_INVALID",
  "traceId": "7f3c9a2e-4b1d-4e8a-9c0f-2a8b6d4e1f30",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T14:30:00.000Z",
  "errors": [
    {
      "field": "sku",
      "code": "VAL_INVALID_FORMAT",
      "message": "SKU must match pattern ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]*$ and be 1–50 characters.",
      "rejectedValue": "widget-01"
    },
    {
      "field": "mrslThresholdDays",
      "code": "VAL_REQUIRED_FIELD",
      "message": "Minimum remaining shelf life days is required when shelfLifeManaged is true.",
      "rejectedValue": null
    }
  ]
}

Business rule link: Validation enforces VR-xxx constraints defined in SRS-API-004; field code may mirror VR ID (e.g. VR-001).

2. Business Errors — 422 Unprocessable Entity

When: Request is well-formed but violates a domain invariant or business rule (L3–L4). Aggregate refuses the command.

Attribute Value
HTTP Status Code 422
Problem Type https://api.ims.example/problems/business-rule-violation
Exception Source BusinessRuleViolationException (Domain)

Standard Error Codes

Error Code Error Message BR VR
BIZ_INSUFFICIENT_ATP Cannot commit quantity exceeding available-to-promise. BR-001 VR-092
BIZ_RESERVATION_EXCEEDS_ATP Reservation quantity exceeds available stock at this location. BR-001, BR-002 VR-092
BIZ_SAFETY_STOCK_BREACH Operation would breach safety stock. Provide an authorized exception reference. BR-010 VR-124, VR-125
BIZ_LOCATION_FROZEN Location is frozen for inventory transactions. BR-024 VR-053
BIZ_PRODUCT_DISCONTINUED Product is discontinued and cannot be ordered or replenished. BR-027 VR-004, VR-120
BIZ_PO_REQUIRED_FOR_RECEIPT A valid purchase order is required before receiving supplier goods. BR-007 VR-040
BIZ_VERIFY_BEFORE_ACCEPTANCE Goods must be verified before acceptance into inventory. BR-004 VR-035
BIZ_PUT_AWAY_REQUIRED Stock is not available until put-away is complete. BR-005 VR-043
BIZ_MRSL_NON_COMPLIANT Remaining shelf life does not meet minimum receiving threshold. BR-016 VR-035
BIZ_LOT_REQUIRED Lot or batch capture is required for this traceable product. BR-017 —
BIZ_SEGREGATION_OF_DUTIES Proposed approver cannot approve this transaction due to segregation of duties. BR-019, BR-021 VR-075, VR-083
BIZ_INVESTIGATION_REQUIRED Variance must be investigated before adjustment submission. BR-022 VR-076
BIZ_BACKORDER_ACK_REQUIRED Customer acknowledgment is required before recording a backorder. BR-028 VR-101
BIZ_SOURCE_MINIMUM_PROTECTED Transfer would breach minimum stock at the source location. BR-012 VR-140
BIZ_NETWORK_TRANSFER_DECLINED Network transfer evaluation must be documented before purchase approval. BR-011 VR-118
BIZ_THREE_WAY_MATCH_INCOMPLETE Payment cannot be authorized until three-way match is complete. BR-008 —
BIZ_RETURN_AUTH_REQUIRED Return authorization is required before receiving customer returns. BR-025 VR-045
BIZ_PROMOTIONAL_RING_FENCE Quantity exceeds promotional ring-fenced allocation. BR-029 VR-127

Details Object Extensions

Field Type Description
businessRuleId String BR-xxx identifier when applicable
validationRuleId String VR-xxx identifier when applicable
details Object Domain-specific context (SKU, quantities, statuses)

Example JSON Response

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/business-rule-violation",
  "title": "Business Rule Violation",
  "status": 422,
  "detail": "Cannot reserve 100 units. Only 45 units are available to promise at this location.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/inventory/stock-positions/WH-EAST/WIDGET-01/reservations",
  "errorCode": "BIZ_INSUFFICIENT_ATP",
  "traceId": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T14:35:12.456Z",
  "businessRuleId": "BR-001",
  "validationRuleId": "VR-092",
  "details": {
    "sku": "WIDGET-01",
    "locationCode": "WH-EAST",
    "orderId": "ORD-2026-004521",
    "orderLineId": "LINE-003",
    "requestedQuantity": {
      "amount": 100.0000,
      "unitOfMeasure": "EA"
    },
    "availableToPromise": {
      "amount": 45.0000,
      "unitOfMeasure": "EA"
    },
    "onHand": {
      "amount": 120.0000,
      "unitOfMeasure": "EA"
    },
    "reserved": {
      "amount": 60.0000,
      "unitOfMeasure": "EA"
    },
    "quarantined": {
      "amount": 15.0000,
      "unitOfMeasure": "EA"
    }
  }
}

3. Authentication Errors — 401 Unauthorized

When: Request lacks valid credentials, token is expired, or authentication fails. No resource existence is implied.

Attribute Value
HTTP Status Code 401
Problem Type https://api.ims.example/problems/authentication-error
Exception Source UnauthorizedException (Application)
Response Header WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="ims-api" when applicable

Standard Error Codes

Error Code Error Message Details
AUTH_MISSING_CREDENTIALS Authentication credentials were not provided. No Authorization header
AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN The access token is invalid or malformed. JWT parse/signature failure
AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED The access token has expired. exp claim in the past
AUTH_SESSION_TERMINATED The session has been terminated. Logout or admin revocation
AUTH_ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED The user account is suspended. Account status check
AUTH_ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED The user account is deactivated. Account status check
AUTH_INTEGRATION_CREDENTIAL_INVALID Integration client credentials are invalid. API-176 ACL inbound

Example JSON Response

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/authentication-error",
  "title": "Authentication Required",
  "status": 401,
  "detail": "The access token has expired. Obtain a new token and retry the request.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/fulfillment/orders/3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6/confirm",
  "errorCode": "AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED",
  "traceId": "c4d5e6f7-8901-2345-6789-abcdef012345",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T14:40:00.000Z",
  "details": {
    "tokenExpiredAt": "2026-07-06T14:38:22.000Z"
  }
}

Security note: Do not reveal whether a user ID exists. Use generic messages for credential failures.

4. Authorization Errors — 403 Forbidden

When: Caller is authenticated but lacks permission, location scope, or role for the action.

Attribute Value
HTTP Status Code 403
Problem Type https://api.ims.example/problems/authorization-error
Exception Source ForbiddenException (Application)

Standard Error Codes

Error Code Error Message Details
AUTHZ_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION You do not have permission to perform this action. Missing role/permission
AUTHZ_LOCATION_SCOPE_DENIED You are not authorized to access this location. VR-008, VR-053
AUTHZ_RESOURCE_SCOPE_DENIED You are not authorized to access this resource. Row-level / ownership
AUTHZ_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD This transaction requires independent approval above your authority. BR-021, VR-082
AUTHZ_PO_AMENDMENT_DENIED You are not authorized to amend or cancel this purchase order. VR-051
AUTHZ_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_DENIED You are not authorized to assign or revoke this role. VR-083
AUTHZ_INTEGRATION_NOT_REGISTERED The integration source system is not registered or enabled. API-176, API-177

Example JSON Response

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/authorization-error",
  "title": "Access Denied",
  "status": 403,
  "detail": "You are not authorized to perform inventory transactions at location WH-WEST.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/inventory/stock-positions/WH-WEST/BOLT-M10/reservations",
  "errorCode": "AUTHZ_LOCATION_SCOPE_DENIED",
  "traceId": "d5e6f7a8-9012-3456-7890-bcdef0123456",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T14:42:18.789Z",
  "validationRuleId": "VR-053",
  "details": {
    "userId": "picker.jones",
    "locationCode": "WH-WEST",
    "requiredPermission": "INVENTORY_RESERVE",
    "authorizedLocations": ["WH-EAST", "WH-CENTRAL"]
  }
}

5. Resource Not Found — 404 Not Found

When: Requested resource does not exist, or exists but is not visible to the caller (optional policy: return 404 instead of 403 to prevent enumeration).

Attribute Value
HTTP Status Code 404
Problem Type https://api.ims.example/problems/not-found
Exception Source NotFoundException (Application)

Standard Error Codes

Error Code Error Message Resource
NF_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND Product not found. SKU (VR-007)
NF_LOCATION_NOT_FOUND Location not found. LocationCode
NF_ORDER_NOT_FOUND Customer order not found. orderId (VR-108)
NF_PURCHASE_ORDER_NOT_FOUND Purchase order not found. purchaseOrderId
NF_GOODS_RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND Goods receipt not found. goodsReceiptId
NF_RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND Reservation not found. reservationId
NF_TRANSFER_NOT_FOUND Stock transfer not found. transferId
NF_ADJUSTMENT_CASE_NOT_FOUND Adjustment case not found. caseId
NF_RETURN_AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND Return authorization not found. VR-149
NF_USER_NOT_FOUND User account not found. userId
NF_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND The requested resource was not found. Generic fallback

Example JSON Response

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/not-found",
  "title": "Resource Not Found",
  "status": 404,
  "detail": "No product exists with SKU 'UNKNOWN-SKU'.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/products/UNKNOWN-SKU",
  "errorCode": "NF_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND",
  "traceId": "e6f7a8b9-0123-4567-8901-cdef01234567",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T14:45:00.000Z",
  "validationRuleId": "VR-007",
  "details": {
    "resourceType": "Product",
    "sku": "UNKNOWN-SKU"
  }
}

6. Conflict — 409 Conflict

When: Request conflicts with current resource state — duplicates, optimistic locking, illegal state transition, or concurrent modification.

Attribute Value
HTTP Status Code 409
Problem Type https://api.ims.example/problems/conflict
Exception Source ConflictException (Application / Domain)

Standard Error Codes

Error Code Error Message Scenario
CONF_DUPLICATE_SKU A product with this SKU already exists. API-001 (VR-002)
CONF_DUPLICATE_BARCODE A product with this barcode already exists. VR-009
CONF_DUPLICATE_LOCATION A location with this code already exists. VR-011
CONF_DUPLICATE_SUPPLIER A supplier with this code already exists. VR-030
CONF_DUPLICATE_INVOICE An invoice with this number already exists for the supplier. API-077
CONF_OPTIMISTIC_LOCK The resource was modified by another user. Refresh and retry. ETag / version mismatch
CONF_INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION The operation is not valid for the current resource status. e.g. ship unconfirmed order
CONF_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED Idempotency key was reused with a different request payload. Financial/reservation commands
CONF_ORDER_ALREADY_CONFIRMED Order is already confirmed. API-085
CONF_RECEIPT_ALREADY_VERIFIED Goods receipt is already verified. API-069
CONF_TRANSFER_NOT_APPROVED Transfer must be approved before dispatch. API-103

Example JSON Response

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/conflict",
  "title": "Resource Conflict",
  "status": 409,
  "detail": "A product with SKU 'BOLT-M10' already exists in the catalog.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/products",
  "errorCode": "CONF_DUPLICATE_SKU",
  "traceId": "f7a8b9c0-1234-5678-9012-def012345678",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T14:48:33.210Z",
  "validationRuleId": "VR-002",
  "details": {
    "resourceType": "Product",
    "sku": "BOLT-M10",
    "existingResourceId": "BOLT-M10",
    "conflictType": "DUPLICATE_KEY"
  }
}

Optimistic Locking Example

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/conflict",
  "title": "Resource Conflict",
  "status": 409,
  "detail": "Purchase order was updated by another user. Retrieve the latest version and retry.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/procurement/purchase-orders/8b2e4f1a-9c3d-4e5f-a6b7-c8d9e0f1a2b3",
  "errorCode": "CONF_OPTIMISTIC_LOCK",
  "traceId": "0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-0abc-def123456789",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T14:50:00.000Z",
  "details": {
    "resourceType": "PurchaseOrder",
    "resourceId": "8b2e4f1a-9c3d-4e5f-a6b7-c8d9e0f1a2b3",
    "expectedVersion": 3,
    "actualVersion": 4
  }
}

7. Internal Server Errors — 500 Internal Server Error

When: Unexpected unhandled exception. Programming defect, unhandled edge case, or non-transient failure not classified as 503.

Attribute Value
HTTP Status Code 500
Problem Type https://api.ims.example/problems/internal-server-error
Exception Source Unhandled Exception (any layer)
Logging Full stack trace logged server-side with traceId (EXC-04)

Standard Error Codes

Error Code Error Message Client exposure
SYS_INTERNAL_ERROR An unexpected error occurred. Contact support with the trace ID. Generic only
SYS_DATA_INTEGRITY_ERROR An unexpected data integrity error occurred. Generic only
SYS_MAPPING_ERROR An unexpected error occurred while processing the response. Generic only

Example JSON Response

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/internal-server-error",
  "title": "Internal Server Error",
  "status": 500,
  "detail": "An unexpected error occurred while processing your request. Contact support and provide the trace ID.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/inbound/goods-receipts/1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7890-abcd-ef1234567890/verify",
  "errorCode": "SYS_INTERNAL_ERROR",
  "traceId": "1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T14:55:00.000Z",
  "details": {
    "supportReference": "1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
  }
}

Prohibited in 500 responses: exception, stackTrace, sql, cause, file paths, connection strings.

8. Service Unavailable — 503 Service Unavailable

When: Transient infrastructure failure — database unreachable, message broker down, dependency timeout after retries exhausted.

Attribute Value
HTTP Status Code 503
Problem Type https://api.ims.example/problems/service-unavailable
Exception Source InfrastructureException (Infrastructure)
Response Header Retry-After: <seconds> when retry is advisable

Standard Error Codes

Error Code Error Message
SYS_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE The service is temporarily unavailable. Please retry later.
SYS_DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT A dependent service did not respond in time. Please retry later.
SYS_MAINTENANCE_MODE The system is under maintenance. Please retry later.

Example JSON Response

{
  "type": "https://api.ims.example/problems/service-unavailable",
  "title": "Service Unavailable",
  "status": 503,
  "detail": "The service is temporarily unavailable due to a database connectivity issue. Please retry after 30 seconds.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/inventory/availability/WIDGET-01",
  "errorCode": "SYS_DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE",
  "traceId": "2b3c4d5e-6f70-8901-bcde-f12345678901",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-06T15:00:00.000Z",
  "details": {
    "retryAfterSeconds": 30
  }
}

HTTP Status Code Summary

Category HTTP Status Problem Type Slug Primary errorCode Prefix

Authentication 401 authentication-error AUTH_
Authorization 403 authorization-error AUTHZ_
Not Found 404 not-found NF_

Exception-to-HTTP Mapping (Implementation Reference)

Aligns with Cross-Cutting Concerns §5.3.

Java Exception HTTP errorCode family

UnauthorizedException 401 AUTH_*
ForbiddenException 403 AUTHZ_*
NotFoundException 404 NF_*
ConflictException 409 CONF_*
BusinessRuleViolationException 422 BIZ_*

Exception (unhandled) 500 SYS_INTERNAL_ERROR

Domain Exception Examples → Error Codes

Domain Exception Error Code BR
InsufficientAtpException BIZ_INSUFFICIENT_ATP BR-001
LocationFrozenException BIZ_LOCATION_FROZEN BR-024
SegregationOfDutiesViolationException BIZ_SEGREGATION_OF_DUTIES BR-019

Response Headers

Header When Value
Content-Type Always application/problem+json
WWW-Authenticate 401 Bearer realm="ims-api"
Retry-After 503 Seconds until retry advised
X-Trace-Id Always Same value as traceId in body
ETag 409 optimistic lock Current resource version when available

Bulk / Partial Success Errors

Import and sync endpoints (API-010, API-147) return 200 OK with per-row errors in the success body for non-blocking validation. Blocking failures use standard error envelope:

Scenario HTTP Pattern
Entire request invalid (empty batch, bad mode) 400 Standard ProblemDetailResponse
Batch has blocking errors on activate 422 BIZ_IMPORT_BLOCKED with error count in details
Per-row errors in validate-only mode 200 errors[] in success response (SRS-API-003)

OpenAPI Schema Sketch

ProblemDetailResponse:
  type: object
  required: [type, title, status, detail, instance, errorCode, traceId, timestamp]
  properties:
    type: { type: string, format: uri }
    title: { type: string }
    status: { type: integer }
    detail: { type: string }
    instance: { type: string }
    errorCode: { type: string }
    traceId: { type: string, format: uuid }
    timestamp: { type: string, format: date-time }
    businessRuleId: { type: string, pattern: '^BR-\\d{3}$' }
    validationRuleId: { type: string, pattern: '^VR-\\d{3}$' }
    details: { type: object, additionalProperties: true }
    errors:
      type: array
      items:
        $ref: '#/components/schemas/FieldError'

FieldError:
  type: object
  required: [field, code, message]
  properties:
    field: { type: string }
    code: { type: string }
    message: { type: string }
    rejectedValue: {}

Document ID: SRS-API-005 | Version 1.0 | July 6, 2026

API Authorization Specification

Inventory Management System

Document Information

Attribute Detail
Document ID SRS-API-007
Document Title API Authorization Specification — RBAC Mapping
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Senior Backend Architect
Source Documents SRS-API-001, project_business/Permissions/rbac-matrix.md, project_business/Permissions/system-permissions.md, SRS-API-005
Date July 6, 2026
Scope Authorization requirements for all 178 REST APIs

Purpose

Maps every REST API to the RBAC model (UR-01–UR-19, PERM-001–PERM-100). For each endpoint specifies authentication, authorized roles, required permissions, sensitive-operation classification, and business justification.

Authorization Model

Request → Authenticate (JWT / Client Credentials)
        → Resolve user roles + location scope
        → Check PERM-xxx (any assigned role grants permission)
        → Enforce location scope on transactional APIs
        → Evaluate SoD on approval APIs (API-031, dual-control endpoints)
        → Execute or 401/403
Mechanism Detail
Authentication OAuth 2.0 Bearer JWT (SVC-01 IdP) for users; Client Credentials for integration principals
Authorization Permission-based (PERM-xxx); roles are permission bundles
Location scope Transactional APIs require locationCode ∈ user's assigned locations (except network-scoped roles)
SoD Initiator ≠ approver enforced at domain layer; pre-checked via API-031 where applicable
Deny default No permission → 403 AUTHZ_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSION

Role Code Reference

Code UR Role
CEO UR-01 Chief Executive Officer
COO UR-02 Chief Operating Officer
CFO UR-03 Chief Financial Officer
OPS_DIR UR-04 Operations Director
INV_CTRL UR-05 Inventory Controller
WH_MGR UR-06 Warehouse Manager
RCV_CLK UR-07 Receiving Clerk
PIK_PAK UR-08 Warehouse Picker / Packer
WH_STF UR-09 Warehouse Staff
REG_MGR UR-10 Regional / Store Manager
SAL_MGR UR-11 Sales Manager
SAL_REP UR-12 Sales Representative
CS_REP UR-13 Customer Service Representative
MKT_MGR UR-14 Marketing Manager
PUR_MGR UR-15 Purchasing Manager
BUYER UR-16 Buyer / Procurement Officer
FIN_MGR UR-17 Finance Manager / Accountant
INT_AUD UR-18 Internal Auditor
EXT_AUD UR-19 External Auditor
SYS_ADMIN — System Administrator (technical; PERM-095/096 only)
INT_SALES — Integration principal — Sales/CRM (EXT-01)
INT_MKT — Integration principal — Marketing (EXT-07)

Sensitive Operation Categories

Code Category Examples
— Not sensitive Read-only visibility, lookups
S1 Approval PO, transfer, adjustment, write-off approvals
S2 Control override Ad-hoc receipt, tolerance override, safety stock override
S3 Governance / policy Policies, thresholds, reason codes, location closure
S4 Financial Valuation, reconciliation, invoice payment
S5 Audit / compliance Audit trail, evidence export, breach records
S6 Master data mutation Product, location, supplier create/update
S7 Identity / admin User provisioning, role assignment
S8 Stock mutation Reservation, shipment, transfer dispatch, adjustments

Location scope key: NET = network-wide; LOC = assigned location(s); NONE = not location-bound; SELF = own session/profile only.

Document ID: SRS-API-007 | Version 1.0 | July 6, 2026

API Versioning Strategy

Inventory Management System

Document Information

Attribute Detail
Document ID SRS-API-008
Document Title API Versioning Strategy — Inventory Management System
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Senior Backend Architect
Source Documents SRS-API-001, SRS-SA-005 (Integration Architecture), SRS-SA-004 (Layered Architecture), ADR backlog item ADR-030
Date July 6, 2026
Scope Public REST APIs under /api; internal domain events are governed separately

Purpose

Defines how the Inventory Management System versions, evolves, deprecates, and retires its REST API surface. Ensures warehouse operations, finance integrations, and external ACL partners (Sales/CRM, Marketing) can adopt changes predictably without disrupting stock integrity or audit trails.

Executive Recommendation

Recommended Strategy: URI Path Versioning (/api/v{major})

Decision Choice
Primary mechanism Major version in URL path — /api/v1/..., /api/v2/...
Secondary signals Deprecation and Sunset HTTP headers on deprecated endpoints
Contract artifact OpenAPI 3 document per major version (openapi-v1.yaml, openapi-v2.yaml)
Release alignment API major version increments only on breaking changes

Why this fits IMS:

  1. Already adopted — All 178 APIs in SRS-API-001 use /api/v1; zero migration cost at launch.
  2. Integration-heavy — EXT-01 (Sales) and EXT-07 (Marketing) partners configure fixed base URLs; path versioning is the most discoverable and gateway-friendly model for B2B ACL.
  3. Operational visibility — Warehouse mobile clients, API gateways, and WAF rules route and log version explicitly.
  4. Enterprise lifecycle — Finance and audit consumers need long deprecation windows; a visible major version supports parallel operation of v1 and v2 during migration.
  5. Team scale — 13 modules share a presentation kernel; path versioning keeps module routing uniform (/api/v1/inventory/..., /api/v1/fulfillment/...).

Not recommended for IMS:

Strategy Reason excluded
Header-only (Accept-Version, custom headers) Harder for operations to debug; integration partners often miss header requirements
Media type (HATEOAS) (application/vnd.ims.v2+json) High complexity for 178 endpoints; limited client ecosystem benefit
Query parameter (?version=2) Cache-unfriendly; easy to omit accidentally on stock-mutation commands

Header-based negotiation may supplement path versioning for minor contract metadata but must not replace the major version in the URL.

1. Version Format

1.1 URL Structure

https://{host}/api/v{major}/{resource-path}
Component Format Example Rules
Base path /api /api Fixed prefix for all REST APIs
Major version v + positive integer v1, v2 No minor/patch in URL
Resource path kebab-case plural nouns /inventory/stock-positions Unversioned within major
Action sub-paths verb noun commands /orders/{id}/confirm Stable within major version

Current baseline: v1 — covers APIs API-001 through API-178.

1.2 API Release Identifier (Documentation)

Each major version has a contract release tag for changelog and OpenAPI publishing:

IMS-API-{major}.{minor}.{patch}
Segment Meaning Example
major Breaking change → new /api/v{n} 2 → /api/v2
minor Backward-compatible addition within same major 1.3.0 — new optional fields, new endpoints
patch Documentation or non-contract fix 1.3.1 — typo in OpenAPI description

Example: IMS-API-1.4.0 = fourth minor release of v1 contract (all under /api/v1).

1.3 Version Discovery Endpoints

Endpoint Auth Response
GET /api/versions Public Supported major versions, current, deprecated, sunset dates
GET /api/v1/openapi Authenticated OpenAPI 3 spec for v1
GET /api/v1/changelog Authenticated Human-readable contract changelog

GET /api/health (API-175) remains unversioned for load balancers.

1.4 Response Headers (All Versioned APIs)

Header When Example
X-API-Version Always 1.4.0 (contract release)
X-API-Major-Version Always 1
Deprecation Deprecated endpoint true
Sunset Deprecated endpoint Sat, 01 Jan 2028 00:00:00 GMT
Link Deprecated endpoint <https://api.ims.example/api/v2/products>; rel="successor-version"

2. Backward Compatibility Approach

2.1 Compatibility Guarantee

Within a major version, IMS guarantees backward compatibility for existing clients:

A client written against contract release IMS-API-1.0.0 must continue to work against IMS-API-1.x.x without code changes.

2.2 Non-Breaking (Allowed in Same Major Version)

Change Type Rule Example
Add optional request field Client may omit New correlationId on command body
Add response field Clients must ignore unknown fields New lastCountedAt on stock position
Add new endpoint No impact on existing GET /api/v1/intelligence/new-report
Add optional query parameter Default preserves prior behavior New filter abcClass on product search
Add enum value Only if clients tolerate unknown values New holdReason=BONDED
Relax validation Wider acceptance Increase pageSize max from 100 to 200
Add HTTP header Optional on request/response X-Trace-Id
Bug fix Correct behavior to match documented contract Fix ATP calculation matching BR-001

2.3 Breaking (Requires New Major Version)

See Section 4. Same major version must never include breaking changes.

2.4 Client Responsibilities (Tolerant Reader Pattern)

Rule Rationale
Ignore unknown JSON properties in responses Forward compatibility
Do not depend on response field ordering JSON is unordered
Treat new enum values as opaque or map to UNKNOWN Enum extension
Use errorCode not HTTP status alone Stable error handling (SRS-API-005)
Pin integration tests to contract release tag Detect unintended drift

2.5 DTO and OpenAPI Versioning

Artifact Versioning
Request DTOs (SRS-API-002) Annotated with since: IMS-API-1.x.0 per field
Response DTOs (SRS-API-003) New fields marked optional in OpenAPI
Validation rules (SRS-API-004) Stricter validation is breaking unless behind new optional field
Error codes (SRS-API-005) New codes are non-breaking; removing/renaming codes is breaking

2.6 Database vs API Versioning

API major version is independent of database schema version. The application layer maps v1 and v2 DTOs to the current domain model via anti-corruption adapters in the presentation layer — domain aggregates do not fork per API version.

3. Deprecation Policy

3.1 Deprecation Triggers

An endpoint or field is deprecated when:

  1. A successor exists in the same or next major version
  2. A module is refactored and the endpoint is superseded
  3. A business process is retired (with BRD approval)
  4. Security or compliance requires replacement

Deprecation does not remove functionality — it signals intent to remove.

3.2 Deprecation Timeline

Consumer Type Minimum Notice Parallel Support
Internal UI (Angular) 1 minor release (≈ 6 weeks) Same major version
Internal modules / BFF 1 minor release Same major version
External integration (EXT-01, EXT-07) 12 months from deprecation announcement v1 + v2 parallel
Partner/custom API consumers 12 months v1 + v2 parallel
Deprecated major version (v1 entire) 18 months after v2 GA Full v1 stack operational

3.3 Deprecation Process

1. Mark deprecated in OpenAPI (deprecated: true)
2. Add Deprecation + Sunset headers on responses
3. Log Warning on each deprecated call (metric: api.deprecated.calls)
4. Publish changelog entry and notify integration owners
5. Update SRS-API-001 with DEPRECATED badge
6. Remove only after sunset date + zero critical consumers

3.4 Deprecation Documentation Requirements

Each deprecation entry must include:

Field Content
Deprecated artifact Endpoint, field, or enum value
Since release IMS-API-1.x.0
Sunset date ISO date
Successor Replacement endpoint or migration path
Migration guide Request/response mapping
Business owner sign-off Product Owner or Integration Architect

3.5 Field-Level Deprecation

Prefer field-level deprecation before endpoint removal:

{
  "sku": "WIDGET-01",
  "legacyBarcode": "12345",
  "_deprecatedFields": ["legacyBarcode"]
}

OpenAPI deprecated: true on the field. Field removed only in next major version.

4. Breaking Change Policy

4.1 Definition

A change is breaking if an existing conforming client would fail or behave differently without modification.

4.2 Breaking Change Catalog

# Breaking Change Example
B1 Remove endpoint Delete GET /api/v1/legacy-report
B2 Remove request/response field Remove mrslThresholdDays
B3 Rename field or endpoint orderedQuantity → quantity
B4 Change field type quantity string → number
B5 Change field semantics atp includes quarantined stock
B6 Add required request field New required reasonCode on POST
B7 Tighten validation SKU max length 50 → 30
B8 Change URL path or HTTP method PATCH → PUT for product update
B9 Change authentication model Bearer scope requirements
B10 Change error code for same condition BIZ_INSUFFICIENT_ATP renamed
B11 Change pagination defaults materially Default pageSize 20 → 5 with no opt-out
B12 Remove enum value Remove DISCONTINUED status
B13 Change idempotency behavior Idempotency key scope change
B14 Change HTTP status for same outcome 201 → 200 for create

4.3 Breaking Change Approval

Step Owner Gate
1. Propose RFC Backend Architect Impact analysis on 178 APIs + integrations
2. Classify breaking/non-breaking API governance board Check against §2.2 / §4.2
3. Business impact review Product Owner Operational/finance impact
4. Integration impact review Integration Architect EXT-01, EXT-07 partner notice
5. Security review Security Engineer Auth/RBAC changes
6. Approve major version bump Tech Lead + PO RFC signed
7. Implement v{n+1} parallel to v{n} Development squads No removal of v{n} until sunset

4.4 Emergency Breaking Changes

Security vulnerabilities (e.g., data exposure, auth bypass) may require accelerated breaking changes:

  • Minimum notice: 30 days for integrations (unless active exploit)
  • Requires CFO/COO notification for finance-facing APIs
  • Documented as SECURITY in changelog

5. Version Lifecycle

5.1 States

PLANNED → BETA → CURRENT → DEPRECATED → SUNSET → RETIRED
State /api/v1 active Headers New clients
PLANNED No — Not accepted
BETA Preview path optional X-API-Version: 2.0.0-beta Opt-in partners only
CURRENT Yes Standard Default for new integrations
DEPRECATED Yes Deprecation: true Discouraged; migrate to CURRENT
SUNSET Yes (limited) Sunset date passed warning Existing only; no new keys
RETIRED No 410 Gone Not accepted

5.2 Multi-Version Operation

During migration from v1 to v2:

                    ┌─────────────────┐
  Client v1 ───────►│  API Gateway    │──────► /api/v1/* → v1 Controllers
                    │  (route by path)│
  Client v2 ───────►│                 │──────► /api/v2/* → v2 Controllers
                    └────────┬────────┘
                             │
                    Shared Application + Domain Layer
                    (DTO adapters per major version)
  • v1 and v2 share domain services and aggregates — only presentation DTOs and controllers differ.
  • Stock mutations from v1 and v2 use the same domain commands — no duplicate business logic.
  • Integration tests run against both versions during overlap period.

5.3 Version Support Matrix (Illustrative)

Major Version Status GA Date Deprecation Sunset Notes
v1 CURRENT Jul 2026 TBD TBD Initial 178-API catalog
v2 PLANNED — — — First major when breaking need arises

6. Implementation Standards

6.1 Code Organization

presentation/
  api/
    v1/
      product/ProductControllerV1.java
      inventory/StockPositionControllerV1.java
    v2/
      product/ProductControllerV2.java
    common/
      VersionFilter.java          # X-API-Version headers
      DeprecationInterceptor.java # Deprecation/Sunset headers

6.2 Spring Boot Routing

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/products")
public class ProductControllerV1 { ... }

Gateway rule: /api/v1/** and /api/v2/** route to same service; unknown version → 404 with available versions in body.

6.3 Contract Testing

Test Type Scope
OpenAPI diff CI fails on breaking change in same major (oasdiff)
Consumer-driven contracts EXT-01, EXT-07 pact tests pinned to IMS-API-1.x.0
Regression suite Golden JSON fixtures per release tag

6.4 Changelog Discipline

Every API change requires an entry in CHANGELOG-API.md:

## [IMS-API-1.5.0] - 2026-09-01
### Added
- API-179 `GET /api/v1/intelligence/reservation-utilization` (non-breaking)

### Deprecated
- `GET /api/v1/intelligence/alerts` — use API-158 filters instead; sunset 2027-09-01

7. Versioning by API Category

Category Version Sensitivity Guidance
Stock mutations (reserve, ship, transfer) High Breaking changes require v2; never alter semantics in minor
Approvals (adjustment, PO, transfer) High Error codes and status transitions are contract
Master data (product, location) Medium Additive fields OK; identifier format changes are breaking
Read/query (intelligence, lists) Medium New filters OK; removing filters is breaking
Integration ACL (API-176–178) Highest 12-month deprecation; partner sign-off on any change
Platform (health, session) Low Health unversioned; session follows auth provider

8. Relationship to Other Versioning Concerns

Concern Versioning mechanism Document
REST API URI /api/v{major} This document
Domain events Event type version + upcasters ADR / event schema catalog
Database schema Flyway migrations SRS-DB
RBAC permissions Additive PERM-xxx only in minor rbac-matrix.md
Error codes Additive in minor; remove in major SRS-API-005

9. Decision Summary

Question Decision
Which versioning strategy? URI path major versioning (/api/v1, /api/v2)
Version format? v{major} in URL; IMS-API-{major}.{minor}.{patch} for contract releases
Backward compatibility? Guaranteed within major; tolerant reader; additive-only minors
Deprecation? Deprecation/Sunset headers; 12-month external notice; documented successors
Breaking changes? New major version only; RFC + governance approval; parallel operation period
When to create v2? First catalogued B1–B14 breaking change that cannot be avoided

Document Approval

Role Name Signature Date
Senior Backend Architect
Solution Architect
Tech Lead
Product Owner
Integration Architect

End of API Versioning Strategy

Document Title Collection API Strategy — Pagination, Filtering, Sorting, Searching
Version 1.0
Status Draft
Document Owner Senior Backend Architect
Source Documents SRS-API-001, SRS-API-002, SRS-API-003, SRS-API-004, SRS-API-005
Date July 6, 2026
Scope All GET collection, search, and list endpoints under /api/v1

Purpose

Defines a consistent, REST-aligned strategy for paginating, filtering, sorting, and searching collection responses across the IMS API surface. Every collection endpoint follows one of five collection profiles with explicit query parameters, defaults, limits, and response metadata.

Design Principles

Principle Implementation
Resource-oriented URLs Collections at plural nouns (/products, /transfers); filters as query params, not path segments
Predictable pagination Offset (page/pageSize) by default; cursor for high-volume feeds
Whitelist sorting sortBy accepts only documented fields per endpoint — unknown values → 400
Explicit filter semantics Each filter documents match type: exact, prefix, partial, range, enum
Scope by default Results constrained to caller's authorized locations unless network-scoped
Empty is success 200 OK with empty data[] — never 404 for zero matches
Stable ordering Tie-breaker sort on primary key (sku, id) when not explicitly sorted
No over-fetching pageSize capped per profile; export endpoints use separate limits

Global Query Parameter Standards

Pagination (Offset — Profile P)

Parameter Type Default Limits Description
page integer 1 min 1 1-based page index
pageSize integer 20 min 1, max per profile Records per page

Behavior: totalPages = ceil(totalElements / pageSize). Requesting page beyond totalPages returns 200 with empty data[] and correct metadata.

Pagination (Cursor — Profile C)

Parameter Type Default Limits Description
cursor string — opaque token Position from prior response links.next
limit integer 100 min 1, max 500 Records per page

Behavior: No totalElements guarantee. Response includes hasMore boolean and nextCursor.

Sorting

Parameter Type Default Description
sortBy string per endpoint Whitelisted field name
sortDirection string per endpoint ASC or DESC

Rules:

  • Invalid sortBy → 400 VAL_INVALID_ENUM
  • sortDirection without sortBy → ignored; default sort applies
  • Compound default: primary business field ASC + id ASC as tie-breaker

Filtering Conventions

Match Type Syntax Example
Exact param=value sku=WIDGET-01
Prefix param=value (documented) sku=WID matches WIDGET-01
Partial (contains) param=value, case-insensitive name=bolt
Enum param=ENUM_VALUE status=OPEN
Boolean param=true|false isActive=true
Date range from/to or startDate/endDate inclusive both ends
Multi-value repeat param or comma-separated locationCode=WH-EAST&locationCode=WH-WEST
Null-safe omit param = no filter —

Searching

Parameter Type Description
q string Cross-field search where supported (max 200 chars)
search string Alternate name on user directory — same semantics as q

Rules: q applies OR across documented fields. Combining q with field filters = AND logic. Minimum 2 characters for q unless exact ID lookup field is used.

Common Date Range Parameters

Parameter Required Max Range Used By
startDate / endDate varies 365 days (audit); 90 days (calendar) Logs, movements, KPIs
*From / *To optional pairs same PO delivery, transfers, counts

Response Metadata Standards

PagedResponse<T> (Offset — extends SRS-API-003)

{
  "data": [ ],
  "page": 1,
  "pageSize": 20,
  "totalElements": 156,
  "totalPages": 8,
  "sort": {
    "field": "name",
    "direction": "ASC"
  },
  "appliedFilters": {
    "lifecycleStatus": "ACTIVE"
  },
  "links": {
    "self": "/api/v1/products?page=1&pageSize=20&lifecycleStatus=ACTIVE",
    "first": "/api/v1/products?page=1&pageSize=20&lifecycleStatus=ACTIVE",
    "prev": null,
    "next": "/api/v1/products?page=2&pageSize=20&lifecycleStatus=ACTIVE",
    "last": "/api/v1/products?page=8&pageSize=20&lifecycleStatus=ACTIVE"
  }
}
Field Type Description
data array Result items for current page
page integer Current page (echo)
pageSize integer Page size (echo)
totalElements long Total matching records
totalPages integer Total pages
sort object Applied sort field and direction
appliedFilters object Echo of non-pagination query params
links object RFC 8288-style pagination URIs (relative)

CursorPagedResponse<T> (Cursor)

{
  "data": [ ],
  "limit": 100,
  "hasMore": true,
  "nextCursor": "eyJvcmRlcklkIjoiLi4uIn0",
  "sort": { "field": "updatedAt", "direction": "DESC" },
  "appliedFilters": { "status": "SHIPPED" }
}

BoundedListResponse<T> (Small nested collections)

{
  "data": [ ],
  "totalElements": 4,
  "truncated": false
}

Used when parent scope bounds result set (e.g. discrepancies on one receipt). Pagination optional; if totalElements > maxPageSize, pagination required.

Response Headers

Header When
X-Total-Count Offset pagination — duplicates totalElements for simple clients
Link Optional RFC 5988 equivalent of links object

Collection Profiles

Profile Code Default pageSize Max pageSize Sort Typical Use
Standard Collection P-STD 20 100 Yes Master data, transactional lists
Operational Queue P-OPS 20 50 Yes Pending approvals, put-away queues
Audit / Log P-LOG 50 100 Yes (timestamp DESC) Movements, audit trail, inquiries
Intelligence Board P-INT 20 100 Yes Dashboards, alerts, boards
Integration Feed C-FED 100 500 Fixed CRM fulfillment status feed
Bounded Nested B-NST all 50 Limited Child collections under parent resource
Report / Aggregate R-AGG n/a n/a n/a Summaries, calendars, KPIs — no pagination

Endpoint Catalog

Legend: Profile = collection profile code. P/S/F = Pagination / Sort / Filter supported.

Error Handling for Collection Queries

Condition HTTP Error Code
Invalid page or pageSize 400 VAL_OUT_OF_RANGE
Invalid sortBy 400 VAL_INVALID_ENUM
Invalid date range 400 VAL_INVALID_DATE_RANGE
Date range exceeds max 400 VAL_OUT_OF_RANGE
Missing required filter 400 VAL_QUERY_FILTER_REQUIRED
Unauthorized location in filter 403 AUTHZ_LOCATION_SCOPE_DENIED

Implementation Notes

  1. Link generation: Preserve all query parameters except page/cursor when building links.next / links.prev.
  2. Count query: Execute COUNT(*) with same WHERE clause; cache counts ≤ 30s for intelligence endpoints.
  3. Index alignment: Every sortBy whitelist field must have a supporting database index or composite index leading column.
  4. OpenAPI: Document per-endpoint sortBy enum and filter match types in parameter descriptions.
  5. Versioning: New sort/filter fields are additive; removing fields requires API version bump.

Document ID: SRS-API-006 | Version 1.0 | July 6, 2026

Part IX — UI/UX Specification

Inventory Management System Screen Inventory

Document Purpose

This document identifies the screens required for the Inventory Management System based on the approved BRD, use-case package, and API design package. It defines the screen inventory only and intentionally does not propose layouts, navigation, or wireframes.

Scope Notes

  • The screen list covers MVP plus approved future-phase capabilities already defined in the BRD, use cases, and API catalog.
  • Screens are defined at page/workspace level. Closely related actions such as create, edit, review, and approve are grouped into one screen when they belong to the same user task.
  • Where the API review identified an unresolved endpoint gap, the affected screen references the current APIs plus the noted gap.

Access and Shared Experience

UI-001

  • Screen name: Sign In / Session Entry
  • Purpose: Authenticate the user and establish the authorized IMS session and role/location context before any protected function is accessed.
  • Primary users: All internal IMS users
  • Related use cases: UC-045
  • Related APIs: API-173 GET /api/v1/auth/session, API-174 POST /api/v1/auth/logout

UI-002

  • Screen name: Operational Home Dashboard
  • Purpose: Provide the day-to-day landing view for operational users with inventory summary, stock health, alert counts, and shortcuts into core workflows.
  • Primary users: Operations Director, Inventory Controller, Warehouse Manager, Purchasing Manager, Sales Manager

Inventory Management System Component Inventory

Purpose

This document defines the reusable UI component inventory for the Inventory Management System. It focuses on shared design elements that can be used across multiple screens, modules, and user roles to support consistency, efficiency, and maintainability.

Scope

The inventory is derived from the screen catalog, navigation structure, user journeys, user flows, and low-fidelity wireframe specifications. It emphasizes reusable components rather than one-off page content.

For each component, this document provides:

  1. Component name
  2. Purpose
  3. Reusability
  4. Variants
  5. Related screens

Global Layout Components

C-001 Global Header

  • Purpose: Provide persistent access to product identity, global search, notifications, tasks, and user account controls.
  • Reusability: Global; used across nearly all authenticated screens.
  • Variants: Standard operational header, executive header, admin-focused header, unauthenticated header.
  • Related screens: UI-002 to UI-050, plus simplified use on UI-001.

C-002 Main Navigation Bar

  • Purpose: Support movement between primary business modules.
  • Reusability: Global; reused across all authenticated screens.
  • Variants: Full menu, role-filtered menu, collapsed menu, highlighted-current-module state.
  • Related screens: UI-002 to UI-050.

C-003 Secondary Navigation Panel

  • Purpose: Organize module-level sections and workflows inside the selected business domain.
  • Reusability: High; reused by all module-driven screens.
  • Variants: Vertical sidebar, horizontal tabs, accordion section list.
  • Related screens: UI-005 to UI-050.

C-004 Breadcrumb Trail

  • Purpose: Show hierarchical location and allow quick return to parent levels.
  • Reusability: Global on all non-home authenticated screens.
  • Variants: Standard breadcrumb, breadcrumb with final record ID, breadcrumb with action state.
  • Related screens: UI-005 to UI-050.

C-005 Page Title Bar

  • Purpose: Provide a page title, context subtitle, primary action, and optional status indicator.
  • Reusability: Very high; present on most application screens.
  • Variants: Simple title bar, title with primary CTA, title with status badge, title with filter controls.
  • Related screens: UI-002 to UI-050.

C-006 Footer Metadata Strip

  • Purpose: Show system metadata such as timestamps, versioning, refresh state, or record audit information.
  • Reusability: High; useful on dashboards, workbenches, and record detail screens.
  • Variants: Page footer, report footer, record audit footer, lightweight timestamp-only footer.
  • Related screens: UI-001 to UI-050.

Navigation and Utility Components

C-007 Global Search Bar

  • Purpose: Let users quickly search products, orders, transfers, users, or other indexed entities from anywhere.
  • Reusability: High; shared utility in the header and some workbench screens.
  • Variants: Header search, contextual scoped search, autocomplete search, advanced search modal.
  • Related screens: UI-002, UI-005, UI-020, UI-021, UI-030, UI-034, UI-049.

C-008 Notification Icon and Inbox Trigger

  • Purpose: Surface pending alerts and open the notification center quickly.
  • Reusability: Global utility for all operational roles.
  • Variants: Header icon with count badge, inline notification shortcut, compact task-alert widget.
  • Related screens: UI-002, UI-004, UI-036, UI-039, UI-047.

C-009 User Menu

  • Purpose: Provide session access, profile/context display, and sign-out actions.
  • Reusability: Global.
  • Variants: Minimal profile menu, profile with role/location context, admin profile menu.
  • Related screens: UI-002 to UI-050.

C-010 Quick Action Tile

  • Purpose: Offer shortcut navigation from dashboards to frequently used tasks.
  • Reusability: Medium to high; mainly used on dashboards and home pages.
  • Variants: Icon tile, KPI-linked tile, role-priority shortcut tile.
  • Related screens: UI-002, UI-003.

C-011 Task / Approval Shortcut Widget

  • Purpose: Summarize work awaiting the current user and route them directly into task queues.
  • Reusability: High for operational and managerial roles.
  • Variants: Approvals summary, task summary, mixed workload widget.
  • Related screens: UI-002, UI-004, UI-025, UI-039, UI-047.

Filter, Search, and Query Components

C-012 Filter Bar

  • Purpose: Narrow lists, reports, dashboards, and queues by key criteria.
  • Reusability: Very high; used across list and analytics screens.
  • Variants: Inline filter row, expandable advanced filters, sticky filter bar, compact dashboard filters.
  • Related screens: UI-002, UI-003, UI-004, UI-005, UI-019, UI-020, UI-022, UI-029, UI-036, UI-041, UI-044, UI-048.
